D5-001.q: Azure Monitor platform metrics kaise hote hain?
opts: Sirf Azure Monitor Agent install karne ke baad collect hote hain, aur taqreeban 30 din rehte hain
Azure resources ke liye baghair extra setup ke khud collect hote hain, aur taqreeban 93 din rakhe jate hain
Hamesha ke liye store hote hain
Sirf P2 licenses ke sath available
D5-001.exp: Platform metrics, jaise VM ka CPU percentage ya storage account ki transactions, Azure resources ke liye baghair extra cost aur baghair agent ke khud collect hote hain, aur taqreeban 93 din rakhe jate hain. Zyada arse ke liye unhein diagnostic setting se kahin aur bhejein. Koi licence nahi chahiye.

D5-002.q: Trend analysis ke liye aap ko VM CPU metrics 2 saal tak rakhne hain. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Kuch nahi; metrics hamesha rakhe jate hain
Diagnostic settings se metrics Log Analytics workspace ko bhejein
Custom storage account ke sath 2 saal ke liye boot diagnostics on karein
D5-002.exp: Platform metrics sirf taqreeban 93 din rakhe jate hain. 2 saal ki history rakhne ke liye aisi diagnostic setting banayen jo metrics ko Log Analytics workspace (kaafi lambi retention ke sath) ya storage account mein bheje. Screenshots analyse hone wala data nahi, aur boot diagnostics console output capture karta hai, metrics nahi.

D5-003.q: Log Analytics mein data kaun si query language analyse karti hai?
D5-003.exp: Log Analytics queries KQL (Kusto Query Language) mein likhi jati hain, ek pipeline language jis mein aap table se shuru kar ke usay where, summarize aur render jaise operators se guzarte hain. SQL, GraphQL aur XPath Log Analytics query karne ke liye use nahi hote (XPath sirf Windows events ke data collection rules mein aata hai).

D5-004.q: Kaun si KQL query pichle ghante mein har computer ke heartbeat records ki tadaad deti hai?
opts: Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize count() by Computer
Heartbeat | order by Computer | extend Count = count(TimeGenerated, 1h) | take 1
D5-004.exp: KQL table (Heartbeat) se shuru hoti hai, where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) se filter karti hai, phir summarize count() by Computer har computer ki rows ginta hai. SELECT SQL hai, aur order by ginne ke baghair sort karta hai.

D5-005.q: Zyada tar Log Analytics tables ki default interactive retention kya hai, aur zyada se zyada kitni configure ho sakti hai?
D5-005.exp: Zyada tar Log Analytics tables default mein data 30 din rakhti hain (interactive retention, jise aap seedha query kar sakte hain). Aap isay 730 din (2 saal) tak barha sakte hain. Is se zyada ke liye long-term retention kam cost par 12 saal tak data rakhti hai, lekin query karne ke liye search job ya restore chahiye.

D5-006.q: Resource ki diagnostic settings kahan bhej sakti hain?
opts: Log Analytics workspace, storage account, event hub, partner solutions
Email address, SMS number, webhook, Automation runbook
D5-006.exp: Diagnostic setting resource ke logs aur metrics chaar qisam ke destinations tak bhej sakti hai: Log Analytics workspace (query ke liye), storage account (sasta archive), Event Hub (doosre tools ko streaming) aur partner solutions. Email aur SMS alerts ki bheji notifications hain, diagnostic destinations nahi.

D5-007.q: Activity log kis sawal ka jawab deta hai?
opts: KIS NE KAUN SA management operation KAB kiya
Application ne KAUN SI exception di, aur KIS line par
D5-007.exp: Activity log control-plane (management) operations record karta hai: kis ne kya kiya — create, update, delete, start, stop — kis resource par, kab, aur kya kamyab hua. Is mein CPU, application exceptions ya network latency jaisa performance data nahi hota.

D5-008.q: Portal mein Activity log events kitne arse rakhe jate hain, aur unhein zyada arse kaise rakhein?
opts: 90 din; diagnostic setting se Log Analytics workspace ya storage mein bhejein
30 din; subscription ko aise support plan par upgrade karein jo ek saal tak rakhe
D5-008.exp: Activity log events 90 din rakhe jate hain. Unhein zyada arse rakhne ya KQL se query karne ke liye subscription par diagnostic setting banayen jo unhein Log Analytics workspace, storage account ya Event Hub mein bheje. Subscription upgrade karne se yeh nahi badalta.

D5-009.q: Azure Monitor alert rule ke main components kya hain?
opts: Scope (target resource), condition (signal logic), aur action group, plus alert details
Workspace (data source), dashboard (visual) aur budget, sath mein owner ki contact details
D5-009.exp: Alert rule scope (kaun se resources dekhne hain), condition (signal, jaise metric, log query ya Activity log event, aur us ki logic), actions (notify ya automate karne wale action groups) aur severity aur naam jaisi details define karta hai. Users aur passwords, telemetry types aur budgets alert rule ka hissa nahi.

D5-010.q: Action group kya kar sakta hai?
opts: Notifications bhejna aur webhooks, Functions ya runbooks jaise actions chalana
Portal notifications dikhana aur alert rule ki severity ya scope badalna
D5-010.exp: Action group notifications (email, SMS, Azure app par push, voice call) aur automated actions (webhook, Azure Function, Logic App, Automation runbook, ITSM, Event Hub) ki dobara use hone wali list hai jo alerts trigger karte hain. Yeh email ya Teams tak mehdood nahi.

D5-011.q: Ek alert rule ko 30 VMs par 5 minute tak CPU > 90% hone par fire hona hai, aur subscription ki aane wali VMs bhi cover honi chahiye. Kya use karein?
opts: 30 alag metric alert rules jo sab ek hi action group use karein
Subscription ya resource group tak scoped, kai resources target karne wala metric alert rule
Subscription par budget alert jo tamam mojooda aur aane wali VMs ko cover kare
D5-011.exp: Metric alert rule poori subscription ya resource group tak resource type (jaise virtual machines) ke sath scope ho sakta hai. Phir yeh har VM ko alag monitor karta hai aur baad mein add hone wali VMs khud shamil karta hai. Tees alag rules maintain karna mushkil hoga, budgets kharcha track karte hain, aur Service Health Azure incidents cover karta hai.

D5-012.q: Planned maintenance window ke dauran darjanon rules edit ya disable kiye baghair alert NOTIFICATIONS rukni chahiye. Kya use karein?
opts: Us waqt ke liye action groups par resource lock, taa ke woh kuch na bhej saken
Alert processing rule jo us scope aur time window ke liye notifications suppress kare
D5-012.exp: Alert processing rule kisi scope (subscription, resource group ya makhsoos resources) ke liye time window ya recurring schedule ke dauran action group notifications suppress kar sakta hai. Alerts phir bhi fire aur record hote hain, lekin kisi ko page nahi kiya jata. Action groups delete karna ya Azure Monitor band karna alerting hi khatam kar dega.

D5-013.q: Metric alerts mein dynamic thresholds kya karte hain?
opts: Threshold ko ek muqarrar percentage se barhate ya kam karte hain jo admin har hafte dalta hai
Metric ki history par machine learning se aam patterns seekhte hain aur un se hatne par alert karte hain
Sirf CPU ke liye kaam karte hain
D5-013.exp: Dynamic thresholds metric ki history par machine learning use kar ke us ka aam pattern seekhte hain, rozana aur haftawar cycles samet, aur jab value tawaqqo ki range se bahar jaye to alert karte hain. Aap ko fixed number ka andaza nahi lagana parta. Yeh zyada tar metrics ke liye kaam karte hain, sirf CPU nahi.

D5-014.q: Fire hue alert ki user-response state ki tarteeb kya hai?
D5-014.exp: Har fire hue alert ki user response state hoti hai jo aap usay handle karte waqt set karte hain: New (abhi fire hua), Acknowledged (koi us par kaam kar raha hai) aur Closed (handle ho gaya). Yeh monitor condition (Fired ya Resolved) se alag hai. Baqi tarteebein mojood nahi.

D5-015.q: VMs se guest OS logs aur performance data Azure Monitor mein collect karne ka mojooda tareeqa kaun sa agent hai, aur yeh kis ke sath jurta hai?
opts: Workspace solutions ke sath Log Analytics (MMA) agent
Data Collection Rules (DCRs) ke sath Azure Monitor Agent
Guest data ke liye agent nahi chahiye
D5-015.exp: Azure Monitor Agent (AMA) Windows events, Syslog aur performance counters jaisa guest OS data collect karne ka mojooda agent hai. Yeh kya collect kare aur kahan bheje, yeh data collection rules (DCRs) define karte hain. Purana Log Analytics (MMA) agent August 2024 mein retire ho gaya. Guest OS data ke liye hamesha agent chahiye.

opts: VMs ke performance charts aur guest OS monitoring data
RBAC reports aur un users aur groups ka map jo monitored VMs mein sign in kar sakte hain
D5-016.exp: VM insights Azure ke khud collect kiye host metrics mein guest OS monitoring ka izafa karta hai: Azure Monitor Agent install karta hai aur ready-made performance charts (CPU, memory, disk, network) deta hai. Us ka purana Map feature, jo Dependency agent par tha, 30 June 2028 ko retire hoga. Yeh billing, RBAC reports ya patching handle nahi karta.

D5-017.q: Perf | where CounterName == "% Processor Time" | summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) mein bin() kya karta hai?
opts: Aggregation ke liye records ko fixed 1-ghanta time buckets mein group karta hai
Output ko sirf pichle ek ghante ke records tak mehdood karta hai
D5-017.exp: bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) har record ka timestamp neeche ghante tak round karta hai, is liye summarize har computer ka har ghante ka average CPU nikal sakta hai. Nateeja ek time series hai jis ka chart ban sakta hai. Yeh rows delete nahi karta, values round nahi karta ya query ko ek ghante tak mehdood nahi karta.

D5-018.q: Storage account ki latency, availability aur capacity ke ready-made views baghair extra setup ke kahan milte hain?
D5-018.exp: Azure Monitor mein Storage insights aap ke storage accounts ke ready-made workbooks deta hai — availability, latency, transactions aur capacity — subscriptions ke aar paar, baghair setup ke kyun ke yeh platform metrics use karta hai. Network Watcher networking ke liye hai, Service Health Azure incidents dikhata hai, aur Advisor recommendations deta hai.

D5-019.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Ek alert rule kai action groups trigger kar sakta hai
Log search alerts schedule par KQL query chalate hain
Near-real-time alerting ke liye metrics logs se behtar hain
VM delete karne se Log Analytics workspace mein us ka pichla data bhi delete ho jata hai
D5-019.exp: Ek alert rule kai action groups trigger kar sakta hai. Log search alerts schedule par KQL query chalate hain. Near-real-time alerts ke liye metrics behtar hain kyun ke woh logs se jaldi pohanchte hain. VM delete karne se workspace mein pehle se mojood us ka data delete nahi hota — woh retention period khatam hone tak rehta hai.

D5-020.q: Log Analytics workspace ki cost ki sab se bari wajah aam tor par kya hoti hai?
D5-020.exp: Log Analytics zyada tar ingest kiye gaye data ke volume (GB per day) ka charge karta hai, aur phir shamil period se zyada retention ka. Users, dashboards aur alert rules asal cost nahi. Data collection rules mein filter kar ke ingestion kam karein, aur mustaqil volumes ke liye commitment tier use karein.

D5-021.q: Network Watcher kaise enable hota hai?
opts: Har region par (zyada tar cases mein VNet banane par khud)
Poori subscription ke liye globally (resource provider register hone par)
D5-021.exp: Network Watcher regional service hai: har subscription mein har region ka ek instance hota hai, aur Azure aam tor par usay khud bana deta hai (NetworkWatcherRG mein) jab aap us region mein VNet banate ya update karte hain. Yeh har VM ya har NSG par enable nahi hota.

D5-022.q: Kaun sa tool jawab deta hai: 'Kya NSGs 10.0.0.4:5000 se 8.8.8.8:443 tak traffic allow karte hain?'
D5-022.exp: IP flow verify VM ke NIC ke liye ek makhsoos 5-tuple — source IP aur port, destination IP aur port, aur protocol — leta hai aur batata hai ke NSG rules usay allow karte hain ya deny, aur kis rule ne faisla kiya. Next hop routing dikhata hai, topology diagram banata hai, aur VPN troubleshoot gateways check karta hai.

D5-023.q: Kaun sa tool jawab deta hai: 'VM1 se 10.2.0.10 tak traffic kaun sa route leta hai — gateway, NVA, ya internet?'
D5-023.exp: Next hop dikhata hai ke Azure VM se destination address tak traffic kahan bhejega: next hop type (jaise Internet, VirtualAppliance ya VirtualNetworkGateway), us ka IP aur zimmedar route table. Connection troubleshoot pohanch test karta hai, NSG diagnostics rules check karta hai, aur packet capture traffic record karta hai.

D5-024.q: Wireshark mein gehre analysis ke liye aap ko VM tak aur us se packets capture karne hain. Kya use karein?
D5-024.exp: Network Watcher packet capture VM tak aur us se packets record karta hai (Network Watcher VM extension use karta hai) aur .cap file storage account ya VM ki disk mein save karta hai, jise aap Wireshark mein khol sakte hain. Activity log, IP flow verify aur effective routes packets ka content capture nahi karte.

D5-025.q: Connection Monitor kis liye use hota hai?
opts: Endpoints ke darmiyan connectivity aur latency ka musalsal test
Endpoints ke darmiyan packets capture kar ke .cap files mein save karna
D5-025.exp: Connection Monitor sources (Azure VMs ya agent wali on-premises machines) se destinations (VMs, FQDNs, URLs ya IPs) tak musalsal connectivity test karta hai, waqt ke sath latency aur failures track karta hai, aur alerts trigger kar sakta hai. Yeh NSGs ki jagah nahi leta, packets capture nahi karta ya billing monitor nahi karta.

D5-026.q: Flow logs kahan store hote hain, aur unhein kya visualize karta hai?
D5-026.exp: NSG aur VNet flow logs storage account mein JSON files ki surat mein likhe jate hain. Traffic Analytics unhein Log Analytics workspace mein process karta hai aur maps, top talkers aur mashkook traffic dikhata hai. Advisor aur Power BI built-in tools nahi, aur logs khud NSG mein store nahi hote.

D5-027.q: Site-to-site VPN tunnel band hai. Kaun si Network Watcher salahiyat gateway aur connection diagnose karti hai?
D5-027.exp: VPN troubleshoot virtual network gateway ya connection check karta hai aur diagnostic report banata hai — maslan IKE negotiation errors ya mismatched shared key — jo storage account mein save hoti hai. IP flow verify aur security group view NSGs ke bare mein hain, aur topology diagram banata hai.

D5-028.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Connection troubleshoot kisi waqt VM se kisi bhi FQDN tak test kar sakta hai
Topology resources aur un ke network rishte dikhata hai
Packet capture ko Network Watcher VM extension chahiye
Next hop dikhata hai ke kis NSG rule ne traffic block kiya
D5-028.exp: Connection troubleshoot us waqt VM se kisi bhi FQDN, URI ya IP tak test kar sakta hai. Topology network resources aur un ka aapas mein judna dikhata hai. Packet capture ko Network Watcher agent VM extension chahiye. Lekin next hop sirf routing (next hop type aur route table) dikhata hai, NSG rules nahi — un ke liye IP flow verify use karein.

D5-029.q: RECOVERY SERVICES vault kaun se workloads protect karta hai?
opts: Azure VMs, VMs mein SQL/SAP HANA, Azure Files, aur MARS/MABS ke zariye on-premises
Azure Blobs, Azure Disks, Azure Database for PostgreSQL
D5-029.exp: Recovery Services vaults Azure VMs, Azure VMs mein chalne wale SQL Server aur SAP HANA, Azure file shares, aur MARS agent ya MABS/DPM ke zariye on-premises machines protect karte hain. Azure Blobs, managed disks aur Azure Database for PostgreSQL is ke bajaye Backup vaults use karte hain.

D5-030.q: Azure Blobs, Azure Disks aur Azure Database for PostgreSQL ke backups kahan jate hain?
D5-030.exp: Backup vaults nayi qisam ke vaults hain, jo Azure Blobs, Azure managed disks aur Azure Database for PostgreSQL (aur doosron) ke liye use hote hain. Recovery Services vaults VMs, VMs ke workloads aur file shares handle karte hain. Storage accounts aur Key Vault backup vaults nahi.

D5-031.q: West Europe ki VMs protect karne wala Recovery Services vault kahan hona chahiye?
D5-031.exp: Recovery Services vault sirf apne region ki VMs protect kar sakta hai, is liye West Europe ki VMs ko West Europe mein vault chahiye. Regional outage se bachne ke liye cross-region restore ke sath GRS, ya Site Recovery use karein — doosre region ka vault nahi.

D5-032.q: Backups ke liye vault ki storage redundancy (LRS/ZRS/GRS) kab badal sakte hain?
opts: Kisi bhi waqt, bas koi job na chal rahi ho
Sirf pehla item protect hone se PEHLE
Kabhi nahi; hamesha GRS hoti hai
D5-032.exp: Vault ki backup storage redundancy (LRS, ZRS ya GRS) sirf pehla item protect karne se pehle badli ja sakti hai. Kuch bhi protect hote hi yeh lock ho jati hai. Baad mein badalne ke liye protection band karein, backup data delete karein, aur dobara configure karein (ya naya vault banayen).

D5-033.q: Standard Azure VM backup policy kitni baar backup le sakti hai?
D5-033.exp: Standard VM backup policy din mein ek backup leti hai. Enhanced policy din mein kai backups (har 4 ghante tak) support karti hai aur kuch VM types, jaise Trusted launch, ke liye zaroori hai. Har 5 minute VM backup ke liye bohat zyada hai.

D5-034.q: Azure VM backup (Standard policy) mein instant restore snapshots locally kitne arse rakhe jate hain?
opts: 1–5 din (default 2), vault se transfer kiye baghair tez restores ke liye
30 din (fixed), kyunke woh vault ke archive tier mein copy hote hain
D5-034.exp: Instant restore backup snapshots ko VM ki disks ke pas locally Standard policy mein 1 se 5 din (default 2; Enhanced policy zyada deti hai) rakhta hai. In snapshots se restore vault se restore ke muqable kahin tez hota hai.

D5-035.q: Azure Backup ki default soft delete setting ke sath delete hua backup data kitna arse rakha jata hai?
opts: Baghair cost ke mazeed 14 din, taa ke wapas mil sake
Archive rate par 90 din aur, taa ke restore ho sake
Yeh khud VM delete hone se rokta hai
D5-035.exp: Azure Backup ka soft delete kisi ke delete karne ke baad backup data ko mazeed 14 din, baghair extra cost ke, rakhta hai, taa ke aap usay undelete kar sakein — maslan ghalti ya attack ke baad. Yeh kisi ko khud VM delete karne se nahi rokta. Retention 14 se 180 din tak set ho sakti hai (14 se zyada dinon ka paisa lagta hai), aur public regions mein soft delete band nahi ho sakta.

D5-036.q: Ek user ne backup hui Azure VM ke andar ek file delete kar di. Sab se tez recovery?
opts: File-level recovery: recovery point mount kar ke file copy karein
Site Recovery test failover chala kar us se file copy karein
D5-036.exp: File-level recovery Azure ke banaye script se recovery point ko machine par drive ke taur par mount karti hai, is liye aap sirf delete hui file wapas copy kar sakte hain. Poori VM restore karne mein kahin zyada waqt lagta hai aur woh usay overwrite ya duplicate karta hai. Templates aur Site Recovery files recover nahi karte.

D5-037.q: Azure VM backup ke kaun se restore options hain?
opts: Nayi VM banana, sirf disks restore karna, mojooda disks replace karna, cross-region restore
On-premises VHDX mein export, NIC replace karna, Blob storage mein file-level restore
D5-037.exp: Azure VM backup restore karte waqt aap nayi VM bana sakte hain, sirf disks restore kar sakte hain (aur khud unhein attach ya customise kar sakte hain, maslan template se), mojooda VM ki disks replace kar sakte hain, ya — agar cross-region restore on ho — paired region mein restore kar sakte hain. File-level recovery bhi hai. Yeh ek tareeqe tak mehdood nahi.

D5-038.q: MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) agent kya karta hai?
opts: Poore Hyper-V hosts aur un ki chalti VMs ka Azure Storage mein backup
Windows machines ki files, folders aur system state ka Azure mein backup
Azure SQL databases ka backup leta hai
D5-038.exp: MARS agent Windows machines (on-premises ya Azure mein) par chalta hai aur files, folders aur system state seedha Recovery Services vault mein, din mein teen baar tak, backup karta hai. Yeh poore Hyper-V hosts ya Azure SQL Database ka backup nahi le sakta, aur Linux par nahi chalta.

D5-039.q: Kai vaults aur subscriptions ke backups ek jagah se manage aur monitor karne ke liye kya use karein?
D5-039.exp: Azure Business Continuity Center, jo portal mein Resiliency search karne se khulta hai, kai vaults, subscriptions aur regions ki protection monitor, manage aur report karne ki ek jagah deta hai. Yeh Backup center ki jagah leta hai, jo ab legacy hai. Har vault alag kholna scale nahi hota, aur Advisor aur Cost Management backups manage nahi karte.

D5-040.q: Recovery Services vault delete karna fail hota hai. Aap ko kya karna hoga?
opts: Backup rokein, backup data delete karein, servers unregister karein, phir vault delete karein
Is ki jagah resource group delete karein, jis se vault ki dependency checks skip ho jati hain
D5-040.exp: Azure aisa Recovery Services vault delete nahi karta jis mein ab bhi protected items ya registered servers hon. Har item ka backup band karein aur us ka data delete karein (soft-deleted items samet), servers aur storage accounts unregister karein, aur phir vault delete karein. Resource group delete karna bhi isi wajah se fail hota hai.

D5-041.q: Azure Site Recovery ka maqsad Azure Backup se kaise mukhtalif hai?
opts: ASR disaster recovery hai (poore workloads replicate aur kam RTO ke sath fail over)
ASR sirf files backup karta hai
Backup regions ki disaster recovery hai; ASR rozana snapshots se single files restore karta hai
D5-041.exp: Azure Site Recovery disaster recovery hai: yeh poori VMs ko musalsal doosre region mein replicate karta hai taa ke aap minton mein fail over kar sakein (kam RTO). Azure Backup data restore karne ke liye point-in-time copies rakhta hai, maslan deletion, corruption ya ransomware ke baad. Zyada tar organizations dono use karti hain.

D5-042.q: ASR ke sath Azure-to-Azure VM replication VMs ko kaise replicate karta hai?
D5-042.exp: Azure-to-Azure disaster recovery mein Site Recovery VM disk changes ko musalsal target region mein replicate karta hai, har chand minute recovery points banata hai, taa ke source region band hone par aap fail over kar sakein. Yeh ek region tak mehdood nahi, haftawar nahi, aur on-premises ke bajaye Azure mein replicate karta hai.

D5-043.q: ASR mein TEST failover kya karta hai?
opts: Replica VMs ko isolated network mein start karta hai, production ya jari replication par koi asar nahi
Production workload ko target region mein le jata hai aur users ke confirm karne par commit kar deta hai
D5-043.exp: Test failover recovery point se aap ke chune isolated network mein replica VMs banata hai, jab ke production chalta rehta hai aur replication jari rehti hai. Isi tarah aap baghair outage sabit karte hain ke disaster recovery kaam karti hai. Baad mein isay saaf karein.

D5-044.q: Multi-tier app ko tarteeb se fail over hona hai (database, phir app, phir web). Kya use karein?
opts: Har tier ke liye alag vaults
D5-044.exp: Site Recovery recovery plan VMs ko tarteeb-war groups mein rakhta hai (maslan databases, phir app servers, phir web servers) jo baari baari fail over hote hain. Yeh groups ke darmiyan scripts, runbooks ya manual steps bhi chala sakta hai. Notes aur alphabetical order automated nahi, aur alag vaults tarteeb control nahi karte.

D5-045.q: RPO aur RTO ka kya matlab hai?
opts: RPO = zyada se zyada qabil-e-qubool data loss; RTO = zyada se zyada qabil-e-qubool downtime
RPO = zyada se zyada qabil-e-qubool downtime; RTO = zyada se zyada qabil-e-qubool data loss
D5-045.exp: RPO (recovery point objective) yeh hai ke aap kitna data khona bardasht kar sakte hain, waqt mein napa jata hai — maslan 15 minute — jo tay karta hai ke recovery points kitni baar chahiye. RTO (recovery time objective) yeh hai ke service dobara chalne se pehle kitni der band reh sakti hai. Yeh alag paimane hain.

D5-046.q: Azure Backup Azure file shares (standard snapshot tier) ko kaise protect karta hai?
opts: Share ki full-copy backups sirf vault mein, jo SMB port 445 par mount karne wala agent leta hai
Backup policy se managed share snapshots, storage account mein stored aur vault se orchestrated
D5-046.exp: Azure file shares ka Azure Backup (snapshot tier) backup policy ke schedule par share snapshots le kar aur vault se un ki retention manage kar ke kaam karta hai. Snapshots storage account mein rehte hain, is liye backups tez hote hain. Vault-standard tier data vault mein bhi copy karta hai. MARS aur AzCopy use nahi hote.

D5-047.q: VM backups ke liye cross-region restore (CRR) aap ko kya karne deta hai?
opts: Sirf Microsoft ke disaster declare karne ke baad restore
Secondary (paired) region mein kisi bhi waqt khud VMs restore karna
Restore blade mein chun kar duniya ke kisi bhi Azure region mein VMs restore karna
D5-047.exp: Cross-region restore (CRR) aap ko jab chahein paired secondary region mein VM backups restore karne deta hai, Microsoft ke disaster declare karne ka intezar kiye baghair. Vault ko CRR enabled ke sath GRS use karna hota hai. Yeh sirf paired region ko target karta hai aur LRS vaults ke sath kaam nahi karta.

D5-048.q: VM backup policy kya define karti hai?
opts: Encryption keys aur VM access permissions
D5-048.exp: VM backup policy schedule (backups kitni baar aur kab chalein) aur retention (daily, weekly, monthly aur yearly recovery points kitne arse rahein) set karti hai, sath mein instant-restore snapshot retention. Yeh VM size, network rules ya encryption keys control nahi karti.

D5-049.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Region A ki VM ka seedha region B ke vault mein backup ho sakta hai
'Retain backup data' ke sath backup band karne se mojooda recovery points use ke qabil rehte hain
ASR DR dene ke sath VMs ko regions ke darmiyan migrate bhi kar sakta hai
Ek VM ek hi waqt mein Azure Backup se protected aur ASR se replicated ho sakti hai
D5-049.exp: VM backups VM wale region ke vault mein jane chahiye, is liye region A se region B kaam nahi karta. 'Retain backup data' ke sath backup band karne se mojooda recovery points restore ke liye available rehte hain. ASR disaster recovery aur regions ke darmiyan VMs migrate karne dono ke liye use ho sakta hai. VM ka backup aur ASR replication ek sath ho sakte hain.

D5-050.ctx: Contoso North Europe mein 20 production VMs chalata hai. Requirements: rozana backups 30 din aur mahana backups 12 mahine rakhe jayen; production par zero asar ke sath har teen mahine DR drill; regional aafat ke 1 ghante ke andar West Europe mein workloads chalein; ek admin ne ghalti se backup data delete kar diya aur woh 2 hafte tak wapas milna chahiye.
D5-050.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Recovery Services vault backup policy daily aur monthly retention poori kar sakti hai
ASR test failover DR drill ki requirement poori karta hai
1-ghante ke regional failover ke liye akela Azure Backup (ASR ke baghair) behtareen hai
Backup soft delete delete hue backup data ko 14 din ke andar wapas lana cover karta hai
D5-050.exp: Recovery Services vault backup policy daily points 30 din aur monthly points 12 mahine rakh sakti hai. ASR test failover production ko chhue baghair isolated network mein DR drill chalata hai. 1 ghante ke andar doosre region mein workloads chalane ke liye ASR chahiye, akela Backup nahi. Backup soft delete delete hua backup data 14 din rakhta hai, jo 2 hafte ki requirement cover karta hai.

Sunday ko action group se SMS receivers hatayen

D5-205.exp: Connection Monitor VMs se api.payments.contoso.com tak port 443 par musalsal connectivity test karta hai, latency aur failures track karta hai, aur alerts utha sakta hai. Kisi bhi region mein Backup vault

D5-207.exp: Azure VMs mein SQL Server ka Azure Backup aksar log backups (har 15 minute tak) aur point-in-time restore support karta hai. MARS agent Windows files aur folders ko backup server ke baghair seedha Recovery Services vault mein backup karta hai.

Items protect hone ke baad vault ki storage redundancy badli ja sakti hai

D5-211.q: Pichle ghante mein har computer ka average CPU dikhane wali query mukammal karein.

Perf
| where TimeGenerated > [[0]](1h)
| where CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| [[1]] avg(CounterValue) by Computer
D5-211.exp: ago(1h) abhi se ek ghanta pehle ka waqt deta hai, is liye where clause pichle ghante ka data rakhta hai. Phir summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer har computer ka average CPU nikalta hai. project sirf columns chunta hai, aur extend unhein add karta hai.

D5-212.q: 15-minute buckets mein events ka chart banane wali query mukammal karein.
D5-212.tpl:
Event
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, [[0]])
| [[1]] timechart
D5-212.exp: KQL time spans 15m (minute), 1h ya 1d ki tarah likhe jate hain, is liye bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) events ko 15-minute buckets mein group karta hai. Phir render timechart nateeje ko time chart ki surat mein banata hai. plot, chart aur draw KQL operators nahi.

D5-213.q: Alerts ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.

D5-213.exp: Alert severity Sev 0 (Critical, sab se sakht) se Sev 4 (Verbose) tak hai. Har fire hue alert ki user response state bhi hoti hai — New, Acknowledged ya Closed — jo aap usay handle karte waqt set karte hain.

D5-214.q: Default retention ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D5-214.tpl: Platform metrics taqreeban [[0]] din, aur Activity log [[1]] din rakhe jate hain.
D5-214.exp: Platform metrics 93 din aur Activity log events 90 din rakhe jate hain. Kisi ko bhi zyada arse rakhne, ya KQL se query karne, ke liye unhein diagnostic setting se Log Analytics workspace ya storage account mein bhejein.

D5-215.q: Azure VM backup ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D5-215.tpl: Backup soft delete delete hua backup data [[0]] din rakhta hai. Instant restore snapshots default mein [[1]] din rakhe jate hain.
D5-215.exp: Soft delete default mein delete hua backup data 14 din rakhta hai, is liye ghalti ya attack ke baad woh wapas mil sakta hai. Instant restore snapshots default mein 2 din rakhe jate hain (Standard policy ke sath 1–5 din), jo haal ke restores ko kahin tez banata hai.

D5-216.q: Har sawal ke liye tool chunein.
D5-216.tpl:
Yeh flow kyun deny hai? [[0]]
Yeh traffic aage kahan jata hai? [[1]]
D5-216.exp: IP flow verify ek makhsoos flow check karta hai aur us NSG rule ka naam batata hai jo usay allow ya deny karta hai. Next hop dikhata hai ke Azure address tak traffic kahan route karta hai aur kaun si route table zimmedar hai.

D5-217.q: Azure-to-Azure disaster recovery ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D5-217.tpl: Recovery Services vault [[0]] region mein banayen. Crash-consistent recovery points har [[1]] bante hain.
D5-217.exp: Azure-to-Azure disaster recovery ke liye vault target region mein jata hai, taa ke source region fail hone par bhi available rahe. Site Recovery har 5 minute crash-consistent recovery points banata hai, aur app-consistent points aap ke chune waqfe par.

D5-218.q: Key vault ke audit logs Log Analytics workspace mein bhejne wali command mukammal karein.
D5-218.exp: --workspace ke sath az monitor diagnostic-settings create key vault ke logs (jaise AuditEvent) Log Analytics workspace mein bhejti hai, jahan aap unhein query kar sakte hain. --storage-account (archive) aur --event-hub (streaming) doosre destinations hain.

D5-219.q: Log Analytics retention ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D5-219.tpl: Default interactive retention [[0]] din hai, aur zyada se zyada interactive retention [[1]] din hai.
D5-219.exp: Zyada tar Log Analytics tables default mein 30 din ki interactive retention rakhti hain, aur aap 730 din tak set kar sakte hain. Long-term retention data ko kam qeemat par kahin zyada arse (12 saal tak) rakh sakti hai.

D5-220.q: MARS agent ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D5-220.tpl: MARS agent din mein [[1]] baar tak [[0]] ka backup leta hai.
D5-220.exp: MARS agent Windows files, folders aur system state ko seedha Recovery Services vault mein, din mein teen baar tak, backup karta hai. Yeh poore Hyper-V hosts (yeh MABS ya DPM karta hai), Linux file systems ya Azure SQL databases ka backup nahi leta.

Diagnostic settings ke zariye storage resource logs
D5-221.exp: Diagnostic setting se bheje gaye storage resource logs data-plane operations record karte hain, jaise blobs kis ne parhe ya likhe. Activity log resource delete karne jaise control-plane operations record karta hai. Windows event logs ke liye Log Analytics mein bhejne wale DCR ke sath Azure Monitor Agent chahiye. CPU trends platform metrics se aate hain, jo khud collect hote hain.

Aap ke region mein Azure outage
CPU 90% se upar
Resource delete hota hai
D5-222.exp: Log search alerts KQL chalate hain; Service Health alerts Azure incidents cover karte hain; metric alerts CPU jaise numbers dekhte hain; Activity log alerts deletions jaise operations dekhte hain.

Azure Blob storage
Azure managed disk
Azure file share
Azure VM mein SQL Server

D5-224.q: Har scenario ko restore option se match karein.

Ek delete hui file wapas lana
Usi VM ki disks wapas pehli halat mein lana
Alag size ke sath VM dobara banana
D5-224.exp: Cross-region restore secondary region use karta hai; file recovery recovery point mount karti hai; Replace existing disks badalta hai; template ke sath disks restore karna changes karne deta hai.

Sab se kam data loss (RPO)
Sab se tez failover (RTO)
D5-225.exp: Latest pehle tamam pending data process karta hai, sab se kam data loss (RPO) deta hai lekin failover slow hota hai. Latest processed pehle se process hua sab se naya point use karta hai, sab se tez failover (RTO) deta hai. Latest app-consistent aakhri application-consistent point use karta hai, is liye apps consistent halat mein shuru hoti hain.

Email aur SMS bhejna aur runbook chalana

On-premises Windows files seedha Azure mein backup karta hai

Har computer ke error counts, A–Z sorted

CPU kam hone par yeh khud resolve hota hai

Failed deployments; kuch set up nahi karna

Abhi restore chal raha hai
vm-web1 ke backup mein taqreeban 13 minute lage
Failed backup jobs built-in Azure Monitor alerts utha sakte hain
D5-232.exp: vm-sql1 ka backup fail hua, is liye us ka koi naya recovery point nahi. Restore job jari hai. 0:12:44 taqreeban 13 minute hai. Azure Backup mein job failures ke liye built-in Azure Monitor alerts hain.

D5-233.q: Kaun si baat is backup policy ko bayan karti hai?
opts: Backups rozana 23:00 UTC par chalte hain
Backups har 2 din chalte hain aur 30 din rakhe jate hain
Backups har ghante chalte hain aur 12 mahine rakhe jate hain
Sirf monthly backups rakhe jate hain
D5-233.exp: Schedule rozana 23:00 UTC par chalta hai. Retention policy 30 daily aur 12 monthly points rakhti hai, aur instantRpRetentionRangeInDays snapshots ko 2 din locally rakhta hai.

D5-234.q: Is replication status ka vm-sql1 ke liye kya matlab hai?

Abhi failover se taqreeban 3 ghante ka data kho sakta hai, is liye replication ki tafteesh chahiye
Yeh pehle hi fail over ho chuki hai
Is ke backups fail hue hain
D5-234.exp: RPO dikhata hai ke replica kitna peeche hai. Critical health ke sath taqreeban 3 ghante ka RPO ka matlab haal ke changes target region tak nahi pohanche, is liye abhi failover se taqreeban 3 ghante ka data kho sakta hai. Replication ki tafteesh karein — maslan network ya disk churn ke masle. Yeh fail over nahi hui, aur is ka backups se taluq nahi.

D5-235.q: Connection Monitor ke nateeje dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:

Round-trip time threshold se guzarne par alert fire ho sakta hai
Nateeje Log Analytics mein store hote hain
Connection Monitor packets ka poora content capture karta hai
D5-235.exp: 0% failed checks ka matlab connectivity healthy hai. Connection Monitor alerting ke liye metrics deta hai aur data Log Analytics mein store karta hai. Yeh packets capture nahi karta; packet capture karta hai.

Logon security events, sath mein CPU aur available memory, law-prod ko

vm-old doosre resource group mein move hui

D5-238.q: Alert processing rule dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:

Window ke dauran action groups email nahi bhejte
Rule doosre resource groups ke resources ke alerts par asar dalta hai
Window ke dauran alert rules disabled hote hain
D5-238.exp: Suppression wala alert processing rule sirf action groups rokta hai, is liye alerts phir bhi fire hote hain aur Azure Monitor mein dikhte hain lekin window ke dauran koi email nahi jati. Is ka scope RG-Prod hai, is liye doosre resource groups par asar nahi. Khud alert rules enabled rehte hain.

D5-239.q: Yeh next hop nateeja aap ko kya batata hai?

rt-spoke-app mein user-defined route traffic ko 10.0.1.4 par network virtual appliance ko bhejta hai
Traffic sirf VNet peering use karta hai
D5-239.exp: Next hop type IP 10.0.1.4 ke sath VirtualAppliance hai, aur nateeja route table rt-spoke-app ka naam leta hai. Is liye us table ka user-defined route traffic ko network virtual appliance ko bhejta hai. Yeh seedha internet nahi ja raha ya sirf peering use nahi kar raha, aur next hop NSGs evaluate nahi karta.

D5-240.q: Backups fail hone ke bawajood yeh query koi row nahi deti. Sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?
opts: Backup jobs kabhi log nahi hote
Vault ki koi diagnostic setting nahi jo Azure Backup data (resource-specific tables) is workspace mein bheje
Is workspace mein job data parhne ke liye query ko Backup Operator role aur Entra ID P2 license chahiye
Failed jobs 1 ghante baad delete ho jate hain
D5-240.exp: AddonAzureBackup* tables sirf tab bharti hain jab vault ki diagnostic setting Azure Backup data resource-specific mode mein us workspace ko bheje. Is ke baghair jobs fail hone par bhi query kuch nahi dhoondti. Backup jobs log hote hain, koi Entra licence nahi chahiye, aur failed jobs ek ghante baad delete nahi hote.

D5-051.q: Azure Monitor ke do buniyadi data types kaun se hain?
D5-051.exp: Azure Monitor do buniyadi qisam ka data store karta hai: metrics (waqt ke sath liye gaye numeric values, charts aur tez alerts ke liye achhe) aur logs (bohat se fields wale records, Log Analytics mein stored aur KQL se query hone wale). Alerts, dashboards, tags aur locks in ke upar bane features hain, data types nahi.

D5-052.q: Portal mein VM ka pichle 24 ghante ka Percentage CPU chart kahan banate hain?
D5-052.exp: Azure Monitor → Metrics (Metrics explorer), ya khud VM par Metrics blade, aap ko kisi bhi time range, pichle 24 ghante samet, ke liye Percentage CPU jaise platform metrics ka chart banane deta hai. Activity log operations dikhata hai, Advisor recommendations deta hai aur Cost analysis kharcha dikhata hai.

D5-053.q: Metrics explorer mein storage transactions ko API name ke hisaab se kaise dekhein?
opts: ApiName dimension par splitting apply karein
Time range control par filter lagayen
D5-053.exp: Bohat se metrics ke dimensions hote hain. Transactions metric ke ApiName dimension par splitting apply karne se har API (GetBlob, PutBlob waghera) ki alag line banti hai. Time range badalna ya chart pin karna usay nahi baantta, aur Activity log mein metrics nahi hote.

D5-054.q: Kaun si aggregation har time grain mein sab se ooncha CPU value dikhati hai?
D5-054.exp: Max aggregation har time interval mein record hui sab se oonchi value dikhati hai, is liye chhote CPU spikes nazar aate rehte hain. Avg unhein hamwar kar deta hai, Sum values jorta hai aur Count samples ginta hai, is liye koi bhi peak nahi.

D5-055.q: Zyada tar platform metrics kitni baar collect hote hain?
D5-055.exp: Zyada tar Azure platform metrics har minute collect hote hain (1-minute granularity), jo unhein taqreeban real-time banata hai. Kuch metrics kam baar collect hote hain, lekin aam waqfa 1 minute hai. Yeh hourly ya daily nahi, aur 10-second collection standard nahi.

D5-056.q: Kaun sa feature portal mein team ke sath charts ka set share karta hai?
opts: Charts ko Azure dashboard par pin kar ke (ya Workbooks use kar ke) share karein
Charts ko Activity log mein export karein aur us ka saved filter share karein
D5-056.exp: Charts ko Azure dashboard par pin kar ke share karein — dashboards Azure resources hain, is liye access RBAC se control hota hai — ya Workbook banayen. Activity log export, budgets aur locks charts share nahi karte.

D5-057.q: Kaun sa Azure Monitor feature text, KQL queries, metrics aur parameters ko interactive reports mein milata hai?
D5-057.exp: Azure Monitor Workbooks text, KQL queries, metrics aur parameters ko interactive reports mein milate hain jinhein log filter aur drill down kar sakte hain. Action groups notifications bhejte hain, alert processing rules alert actions badalte hain, aur DCRs data collection define karte hain.

D5-058.q: Kya agent ke baghair guest OS ka data, jaise disk ki khaali jagah ya Windows events, collect ho sakta hai?
opts: Nahi — guest OS data ke liye Azure Monitor Agent chahiye
Haan — platform metrics mein tamam guest OS data hota hai
D5-058.exp: Platform metrics woh cover karte hain jo Azure VM ke liye khud collect karta hai, jaise CPU, network, disk operations aur available memory. Disk ki khaali jagah ya Windows events jaise guest OS data ko data collection rule ke sath Azure Monitor Agent chahiye. Windows aur Linux dono ke liye yahi hai, disk type chahe kuch bhi ho.

opts: Azure Monitor mein log data ka ek alag environment, apne data, retention aur access configuration ke sath
Shared dashboard jo ek resource group ki chart definitions, alert rules aur metric data rakhta hai
D5-059.exp: Log Analytics workspace woh jagah hai jahan Azure Monitor log data store karta hai. Har workspace ka apna data, retention settings, pricing tier aur access control hota hai, aur aap usay KQL se query karte hain. Yeh VM, storage container ya dashboard nahi.

D5-060.q: Kaun si CLI command Log Analytics workspace banati hai?
