az monitor workspace add -g RG1 -n law1 --type log-analytics
D5-060.exp: az monitor log-analytics workspace create Log Analytics workspace banati hai (-g aur -n ke sath, sath mein optional location, SKU aur retention). Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D5-061.q: Users ko workspace-wide permissions ke baghair sirf un resources ka log data dikhna chahiye jin tak un ka access hai. Kaun sa access mode?
D5-061.exp: Workspace access control mode 'Use resource or workspace permissions' par set hone se users resource context mein logs query kar sakte hain: woh sirf un resources ka data dekhte hain jin tak un ka Azure RBAC access hai, poore workspace par permissions ke baghair. Workspaces kabhi public nahi hote, aur shared keys agents ke liye hain, users ke liye nahi.

D5-062.q: Kaun sa role user ko workspace ka tamam data parhne aur queries chalane deta hai lekin settings badalne nahi deta?
D5-062.exp: Log Analytics Reader workspace ka tamam data dekh aur query kar sakta hai aur us ki settings dekh sakta hai, lekin kuch badal nahi sakta. Log Analytics Contributor aur Monitoring Contributor settings badal sakte hain, aur Owner sab kuch kar sakta hai.

D5-063.q: Compliance ke liye data 7 saal rakhna hai lekin kam hi query hota hai. Log Analytics mein sab se sasta tareeqa?
opts: Purane data ke liye long-term retention (archive), zaroorat par restore ya search jobs ke sath
Har table par 7 saal ki interactive retention, daily ingestion cap ke sath
D5-063.exp: Log Analytics long-term retention ke sath data 12 saal tak rakh sakta hai, interactive retention se kahin saste mein. Aap isay seedha query nahi kar sakte, lekin zaroorat par search job ya restore se wapas la sakte hain. 7 saal interactive rakhna kahin mehnga hai, aur 30 din baad delete karna compliance tor deta hai.

D5-064.q: Ingestion taqreeban 300 GB/day aur mustaqil hai. Per GB cost kaise kam karein?
opts: Commitment tier pricing level use karein
Data ko zyada workspaces mein baantein
D5-064.exp: Commitment tiers rozana ingestion volume (maslan 300 GB/day) ka commitment karne par per GB kam qeemat dete hain, jo pehle se maloom workloads ke liye munasib hai. Is volume par Pay-as-you-go zyada mehnga hai. Zyada workspaces banana ya retention barhana per GB cost kam nahi karta.

D5-065.q: Aap ghair-mutawaqqa bills se bachne ke liye ingestion par had lagana chahte hain. Kaun si workspace setting?
D5-065.exp: Daily cap had pohanchte hi din ke baqi hisse ke liye workspace mein data collection rok deta hai, jo ghair-mutawaqqa bills se bachata hai. Badle mein cap ke baad ka data kho jata hai. Retention, access mode aur data export ingestion mehdood nahi karte.

D5-066.q: Kaun si CLI command Key Vault ke AuditEvent logs workspace mein bhejne wali diagnostic setting banati hai?
D5-066.exp: az monitor diagnostic-settings create resource ke logs destination tak bhejti hai: --resource key vault ki ID hai, --workspace Log Analytics workspace, aur --logs categories list karta hai, yahan AuditEvent. Key vaults ki apni koi logging command nahi, aur baqi commands mojood nahi.

D5-067.q: Subscription ke har naye Key Vault par diagnostic settings khud apply honi chahiye. Behtareen tareeqa?
opts: DeployIfNotExists diagnostic settings definition wali Azure Policy
Activity log alert rule jo Key Vault banne par chale
D5-067.exp: DeployIfNotExists effect wali built-in Azure Policy definition har key vault par, naye samet, diagnostic setting khud bana sakti hai, aur remediation task mojooda vaults theek karta hai. Har vault haath se configure karna scale nahi hota, aur locks aur alerts settings nahi banate.

D5-068.q: Logs taqreeban real time mein third-party SIEM tak stream hone chahiye. Kaun sa destination?
D5-068.exp: Event Hub destination logs ko third-party SIEM jaise bahar ke systems tak taqreeban real time mein stream karta hai. Storage account saste long-term archive ke liye hai, aur email aur dashboards diagnostic setting destinations nahi.

D5-069.q: Ek resource ki kitni diagnostic settings ho sakti hain?
D5-069.exp: Har resource ki 5 tak diagnostic settings ho sakti hain — maslan ek Log Analytics ko, ek storage ko aur ek Event Hub ko, har ek alag categories ke sath. Yeh 1 tak mehdood nahi, aur unlimited bhi nahi.

D5-070.q: Kal VM1 kis ne delete ki? Pehle kahan dekhenge?
opts: Delete operation par filter kiya Activity log
Metrics, VM availability par filter ke sath
D5-070.exp: VM delete karna control-plane operation hai, is liye Activity log usay caller ki identity, waqt aur status ke sath record karta hai. Isay delete operation par filter karein. VM insights, metrics aur boot diagnostics performance aur console output dikhate hain, yeh nahi ke kis ne kya kiya.

D5-071.q: Activity log ki kaun si event categories hain?
opts: Administrative, Service Health, Resource Health, Alert, Autoscale, Recommendation, Security, Policy
Metrics, Logs, Traces, Changes, Heartbeat, Performance, Syslog, Custom tables aur Events
D5-071.exp: Activity log ki kai categories hain: Administrative (create, update, delete), Service Health, Resource Health, Alert, Autoscale, Recommendation (Advisor se), Security (Defender for Cloud se) aur Policy. Yeh administrative operations se zyada cover karta hai, aur is mein metrics nahi hote.

D5-072.q: Kya blob uploads (data-plane operations) Activity log mein aate hain?
opts: Nahi — sirf control-plane operations; data-plane operations ko resource logs chahiye
Haan — control-plane aur data-plane dono operations 90 din tak record hote hain
D5-072.exp: Activity log sirf control-plane operations record karta hai, jaise storage account banana ya us ki settings badalna. Blobs upload, parhne ya delete karne jaise data-plane operations ko diagnostic setting ke zariye bheje gaye storage resource logs (StorageRead, StorageWrite, StorageDelete) chahiye.

D5-073.q: Kaun sa KQL operator output ke columns chunta hai?
D5-073.exp: project chunta hai ke output mein kaun se columns aayen, aur unhein rename kar sakta hai (project Name = Computer). where rows filter karta hai, summarize unhein aggregate karta hai (count, avg waghera), aur extend mojooda columns rakhte hue calculated columns add karta hai.

D5-074.q: Kaun si KQL query sab se zyada average CPU wale 10 computers return karti hai?
opts: Perf | where CounterName == "% Processor Time" | summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer | top 10 by avg_CounterValue desc
Perf | where CounterName == "% Processor Time" | order by CounterValue asc | summarize by Computer | limit 10 by avg desc
D5-074.exp: Pehle Perf ko CPU counter tak filter karein, phir har computer ka average nikalne ke liye summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer, phir sab se oonche das rakhne ke liye top 10 by avg_CounterValue desc. take 10 koi bhi das rows deta hai, aur SELECT TOP SQL hai.

D5-075.q: Kaun sa KQL operator naya calculated column add karta hai?
D5-075.exp: extend expression se calculate hua naya column add karta hai, maslan extend CpuPercent = CounterValue / 100. project-away columns hatata hai, join tables jorta hai aur render charts banata hai.

D5-076.q: Kaun si query pichle 24 ghante ke Windows error events dikhati hai?
opts: Event | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and EventLevelName == "Error"
Syslog | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and SeverityLevel == "Windows"
D5-076.exp: Agent ke collect kiye Windows event logs Event table mein jate hain, is liye usay where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) aur EventLevelName == "Error" se filter karein. Syslog Linux ka barabar hai, aur AzureActivity Azure control-plane operations rakhta hai.

D5-077.q: Kaun sa KQL operator query nateejon se timechart banata hai?
D5-077.exp: render timechart query ke nateeje ko waqt ke sath line chart ki surat mein banata hai, aam tor par summarize ... by bin(TimeGenerated, ...) ke baad. render barchart, piechart, columnchart waghera bhi support karta hai. plot, chart() aur graph KQL operators nahi.

D5-078.q: Activity log se workspace mein bheje gaye Azure control-plane operations kaun si table mein hote hain?
D5-078.exp: Jab Activity log Log Analytics workspace mein bheja jaye to us ke records AzureActivity table mein jate hain, jis mein caller, operation aur status hota hai. AzureDiagnostics resource logs rakhti hai, Heartbeat agent heartbeats aur Perf performance counters.

D5-079.q: Kaun si query un VMs ko dhoondti hai jinhon ne pichle 15 minute mein heartbeat nahi bheja?
opts: Heartbeat | summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | where LastSeen < ago(15m)
Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated < ago(15m) | summarize LastSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by Computer
D5-079.exp: summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer har computer ka sab se haal ka heartbeat dhoondta hai, aur where LastSeen < ago(15m) sirf un computers ko rakhta hai jin ka aakhri heartbeat 15 minute se purana hai, yani jinhon ne report karna band kar diya. Baqi queries khamosh machines ke bajaye purani ya koi bhi rows deti hain.

D5-080.q: Ek computer ka har ghante ka average CPU chart karne ke KQL pipeline steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: render timechart
Perf
summarize avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
where Computer == "VM1" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
D5-080.exp: Har KQL query table (Perf) se shuru hoti hai, phir where se filter karti hai (computer aur counter), phir hourly averages ke liye summarize ... by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) se aggregate karti hai, aur aakhir mein render timechart chart banata hai. Har step pichle step ke output par kaam karta hai.

D5-081.q: Data Collection Rule (DCR) kya define karti hai?
opts: Kya data collect karna hai (events, counters, logs), kin machines se, aur kahan bhejna hai
Har machine ke alert thresholds, action groups aur time windows
D5-081.exp: Data collection rule (DCR) Azure Monitor Agent ko batati hai ke kya collect kare (Windows events, performance counters, Syslog, text logs), yeh kin machines par apply ho (DCR associations ke zariye), koi transformations, aur data kahan bheje (maslan Log Analytics workspace). Yeh alerts, roles ya backups define nahi karti.

D5-082.q: AMA se sirf IDs 4624 aur 4625 wale Windows Security events (cost kam karne ke liye) kaise collect karein?
opts: DCR ke Windows event log data source mein XPath query filter use karein
Tamam events collect kar ke baad mein delete karein
SecurityEvent table ke liye workspace par daily cap lagayen
D5-082.exp: DCR ka Windows event log data source XPath queries leta hai, jaise Security!*[System[(EventID=4624 or EventID=4625)]], is liye agent sirf woh events collect karta hai aur aap kam data ke paise dete hain. Sab collect kar ke baad delete karne mein phir bhi ingestion ki cost lagti hai, MMA retire ho chuka, aur daily cap filter karne ke bajaye data gira deta hai.

D5-083.q: Kya ek DCR kai VMs se associate ho sakti hai, aur kya ek VM ki kai DCRs ho sakti hain?
opts: Har VM ki sirf ek DCR
Har DCR ki sirf ek VM
D5-083.exp: DCR associations many-to-many hain: ek DCR kai machines se associate ho sakti hai, aur ek machine ki kai DCRs ho sakti hain (maslan ek standard security DCR plus ek app-specific).

D5-084.q: On-premises servers ko AMA se Azure Monitor mein logs bhejne hain. Pehle kya zaroori hai?
opts: Unhein Azure Arc par onboard karein, phir AMA ko extension ke taur par install karein
MMA agent install karein, phir policy se usay AMA par upgrade karein
D5-084.exp: Azure Monitor Agent ghair-Azure machines par sirf tab chalta hai jab woh Azure Arc par onboard hon, jo unhein Azure identity deta hai aur AMA ko extension ke taur par install karne deta hai. Purana MMA agent retire ho chuka, aur Network Watcher logs collect nahi karta.

D5-085.q: Azure Monitor Agent data bhejte waqt authenticate karne ke liye kaun si identity use karta hai?
D5-085.exp: Azure Monitor Agent Azure Monitor se managed identity ke zariye authenticate karta hai — system-assigned ya user-assigned, ya Arc machines ke liye un ki Arc identity — is liye koi workspace keys ya secrets store nahi hote. Purana agent workspace ID aur key use karta tha.

D5-086.q: VM insights enable karne se kya hota hai?
opts: AMA install karta hai aur performance data bhejne wala DCR banata hai
Disk encryption on karta hai aur us ke key logs workspace ko bhejta hai
D5-086.exp: VM insights enable karne se Azure Monitor Agent install hota hai (purana Dependency agent aur Map feature deprecated hain) aur aisi data collection rule banti hai jo performance data Log Analytics workspace mein bheje. Yeh backup ya encryption on nahi karta ya public IP add nahi karta.

D5-087.q: Ek mojooda deployment deprecated Dependency agent use karta hai. Kaun sa VM insights feature dikhata hai ke VM kin servers se connect hoti hai aur kaun se processes kin ports par sunte hain?
D5-087.exp: VM insights ka Map feature, jo Dependency agent use karta hai, har VM par chalne wale processes, un ke sune jane wale ports, aur doosri machines se inbound aur outbound connections dikhata hai. Performance sirf charts dikhata hai, aur workbooks reports hain. Map aur Dependency agent 30 June 2028 ko retire honge, is liye naye deployments mein enable na karein.

D5-088.q: Kaun sa experience subscriptions ke aar paar network health, connectivity, traffic aur topology ek jagah dikhata hai?
D5-088.exp: Azure Monitor mein Network insights subscriptions ke aar paar networking resources ki network health, connectivity, traffic aur topology ka ek view deta hai, baghair setup ke. VM insights VMs ke liye hai, Storage insights storage ke liye, aur Cost analysis kharche ke liye.

D5-089.q: Kaun si service SDK ya auto-instrumentation ke zariye live web application ki performance, failures aur dependencies monitor karti hai?
D5-089.exp: Application Insights Azure Monitor ka application performance monitoring (APM) feature hai. SDK ya auto-instrumentation ke zariye yeh live web apps se requests, response times, failures, exceptions aur dependencies ki calls collect karta hai. VM insights VMs monitor karta hai, Network Watcher networks diagnose karta hai, aur Advisor recommendations deta hai.

D5-090.q: Jab Azure mein aap ke regions aur services ko mutasir karne wala outage ya planned maintenance ho to aap ko email chahiye. Kya configure karein?
D5-090.exp: Service Health alert action group ke zariye aap ko un Azure service issues, planned maintenance aur health advisories ke bare mein batata hai jo aap ki subscriptions, regions aur services ko mutasir karein. Metric alerts aap ke apne resources dekhte hain, budgets kharcha dekhte hain, aur Resource Health individual resources cover karta hai.

D5-091.q: Service Health aur Resource Health mein kya farq hai?
opts: Service Health regions mein Azure service issues cover karta hai; Resource Health aap ke individual resources ki sehat dikhata hai
Resource Health regions mein Azure service issues cover karta hai; Service Health aap ki individual VMs ki sehat dikhata hai
Service Health sirf VMs ke liye hai
D5-091.exp: Service Health aap ko un regions mein Azure services ke maslon ke bare mein batata hai jo aap use karte hain, jaise outages aur planned maintenance. Resource Health batata hai ke aap ka makhsoos resource — maslan VM1 — abhi available hai ya nahi, aur nahi to kyun. Yeh alag views hain, aur koi bhi billing ke bare mein nahi.

D5-092.q: Kaun sa alert signal kisi makhsoos resource ke delete hone par fire hota hai?
opts: Delete operation par Activity log alert
Perf table par log search alert
D5-092.exp: Activity log alert tab fire hota hai jab koi makhsoos control-plane event ho, jaise kisi resource ya resource group par delete operation. Metric alerts numeric values dekhte hain, Perf par log alerts performance data dekhte hain, aur smart detection Application Insights ka feature hai.

D5-093.q: Log search alert har 5 minute 5-minute windows par chalta hai lekin kabhi kabhi events miss kar deta hai. Kyun?
D5-093.exp: Log data ko workspace tak pohanchne mein waqt lagta hai (ingestion latency, aksar chand minute). Agar rule har 5 minute pichle 5 minute check kare to der se aane wale records har evaluate hone wali window se bahar reh kar miss ho sakte hain. Frequency se lambi window use karein, ya takheer ki gunjaish rakhein.

D5-094.q: Kaun si alert severity sab se critical hai?
D5-094.exp: Alert severities Sev 0 (Critical) se Sev 1 (Error), Sev 2 (Warning) aur Sev 3 (Informational) se hote hue Sev 4 (Verbose) tak hain. Sev 0 sab se critical hai — kam number ka matlab zyada sangeen alert.

D5-095.q: CPU threshold se neeche wapas aane par alerts khud resolve hone chahiye. Kaun sa option?
D5-095.exp: 'Automatically resolve alerts' (stateful alerts) enabled hone par metric threshold se neeche aate hi alert ki monitor condition Resolved ho jati hai, aur resolution notifications bheji ja sakti hain. Mute actions sirf notifications band karta hai, processing rules actions badalte hain, aur dynamic thresholds threshold calculate karne ka tareeqa badalte hain.

D5-096.q: Alert ko VM khud restart karni hai. Kaun sa action group action munasib hai?
opts: VM restart karne wala Automation runbook (ya Logic App/Function)
Voice call jo on-call engineer ko VM restart karne ka kahe
D5-096.exp: Action group Azure Automation runbook (ya Logic App ya Azure Function) chala sakta hai jo VM restart kare, is liye alert khud masla theek kar deta hai. Email aur voice calls sirf logon ko batate hain, aur budgets cost track karte hain.

D5-097.q: Kaun sa action group notification option users ko RBAC role ke hisaab se email karta hai (maslan subscription ke tamam Owners)?
D5-097.exp: 'Email Azure Resource Manager role' notification subscription par chune hue role, jaise Owner ya Contributor, wale har shakhs ko email bhejti hai. Aap ko addresses ki list maintain nahi karni, kyun ke recipients role assignments ke sath chalte hain. Saada email/SMS/push/voice fixed addresses mangta hai, aur webhooks aur ITSM logon ke bajaye systems call karte hain.

D5-098.q: Ops team ko email karne wala CPU alert banane ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Alert rule banayen: scope VM1, condition 5 min tak Percentage CPU > 85%
Ops team ki email ke sath action group banayen
Action group ko alert rule se attach karein aur severity set karein
CPU spike ya Test action group feature se test karein
D5-098.exp: Pehle ops team ki email ke sath action group banayen, kyun ke alert rule sirf pehle se mojood action group attach kar sakta hai. Phir scope (VM1) aur condition (5 minute tak CPU 85% se upar) ke sath alert rule banayen, action group attach karein aur severity set karein, aur aakhir mein test karein — maslan 'Test action group' feature se.

D5-099.q: Alert processing rule kaun se DO kaam kar sakta hai?
opts: Maintenance window ke dauran action group notifications suppress karna
Subscription mein fire hone wale tamam alerts mein action group add karna
D5-099.exp: Alert processing rules alerts fire hone ke baad un par kaam karte hain: yeh action group notifications suppress kar sakte hain (maslan maintenance window ke dauran) ya kisi scope ke har alert mein action groups add kar sakte hain. Yeh alert rule ki condition ya threshold nahi badal sakte, aur fire hue alerts delete nahi karte.

D5-100.ctx: VM1 par AMA hai aur ek DCR perf counters LAW1 ko bhejti hai. Metric alert (CPU > 90%) aur log search alert (Perf se free memory < 500 MB) dono action group AG-Ops use karte hain.
D5-100.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: CPU alert condition ke taqreeban ek minute ke andar fire ho sakta hai
Memory alert AMA ke collect kiye data par depend karta hai
DCR hatane se memory alert ko naya data milna band ho jata hai
AG-Ops dono alert rules mein share ho sakta hai
D5-100.exp: CPU jaise platform metrics taqreeban real-time hain, is liye metric alert taqreeban ek minute mein fire ho sakta hai. Free memory in-guest counter hai jo AMA DCR ke zariye collect karta hai, is liye log alert us par depend karta hai — DCR hatayen to naya data nahi aata. Ek action group bohat se alert rules mein share ho sakta hai.

opts: Azure IaaS mein network halat monitor aur diagnose karne ki regional service
Azure IaaS mein network traffic filter aur inspect karne wali global service
D5-101.exp: Network Watcher Azure IaaS mein network masle monitor aur diagnose karne ke regional tools ka set hai — IP flow verify, next hop, connection troubleshoot, packet capture, flow logs aur mazeed. Yeh DNS service, firewall ya load balancer nahi; yeh sirf dekhta aur test karta hai.

D5-102.q: Default mein Network Watcher instances kaun se resource group mein bante hain?
D5-102.exp: Jab kisi region ke liye Network Watcher khud enable hota hai to Azure us ka instance NetworkWatcherRG naam ke resource group mein banata hai. Yeh VNet ke resource group ya 'DefaultResourceGroup' mein nahi jata. Manually enable karne par aap isay kahin aur bana sakte hain.

D5-103.q: IP flow verify rule name 'DenyAllInBound' ke sath 'Access denied' report karta hai. Is ka kya matlab hai?
opts: Koi custom NSG rule flow allow nahi karta, is liye default deny match hua
Routing fail hui, is liye packet kisi NSG rule se pehle drop ho gaya
D5-103.exp: DenyAllInBound default NSG rules mein se ek hai, sab se kam priority (65500) ke sath. Agar yahi match hua to kisi zyada priority wale rule — aap ke banaye kisi custom rule samet — ne traffic allow nahi kiya. Hal kam priority number wala allow rule hai. Custom deny rule apna naam dikhata.

D5-104.q: Next hop VM1 se 10.5.0.4 tak traffic ke liye 'None' return karta hai. Is ka kya matlab hai?
opts: Next hop None wala route (ya koi matching route nahi) traffic drop karta hai
Traffic internet jata hai, kyunke Azure mein koi route match nahi karta
D5-104.exp: None next hop ka matlab Azure traffic drop karta hai: ya to next hop type None wala route destination se match karta hai, ya koi route match hi nahi karta. Traffic internet, NVA ya peering par nahi jata — woh Internet, VirtualAppliance ya VNetPeering dikhate.

D5-105.q: Next hop internet ki taraf traffic ke liye 'VirtualAppliance 10.0.1.4' report karta hai. Yeh aap ko kya batata hai?
opts: UDR traffic ko 10.0.1.4 par NVA se guzarne par majboor karta hai
NSG rule traffic ko host 10.0.1.4 ki taraf mor deta hai
D5-105.exp: IP 10.0.1.4 ke sath VirtualAppliance next hop type ka matlab user-defined route yeh traffic us address par network virtual appliance ko bhejta hai, aur next hop yeh bhi batata hai ke route kis route table mein hai. Next hop sirf routing ke bare mein hai, is liye NSGs ya DNS ke bare mein kuch nahi batata.

D5-106.q: Packet capture 10 minute ya 1 GB ke baad khud ruk jana chahiye. Kya yeh configurable hai?
opts: Haan — capture time limit, bytes per packet aur total size filters ke sath configurable hain
Nahi — har capture haath se rokne tak chalta hai, aur sirf filters set ho sakte hain
D5-106.exp: Packet capture shuru karte waqt aap time limit, zyada se zyada total size, har packet ke capture hone wale bytes, aur filters (protocol, IPs aur ports) set kar sakte hain. In mein se kisi bhi had par pohanchne par capture ruk jata hai, is liye 10 minute ya 1 GB configure karna aasan hai.

D5-107.q: VM ka network metric threshold se guzarne par packet capture khud shuru hona chahiye. Kaise?
opts: Alert Azure Function ya Automation runbook trigger karta hai jo Network Watcher packet capture shuru kare
Traffic Analytics wala flow log khud hi Network Watcher packet capture shuru kar deta hai
D5-107.exp: Packet capture khud shuru nahi hota. Isay khud trigger karne ke liye metric par aisa alert banayen jis ka action group Azure Function ya Automation runbook chalaye jo Network Watcher ko capture shuru karne ke liye call kare. Flow logs sirf flow summaries record karte hain, aur Advisor recommendations deta hai.

D5-108.q: Connection troubleshoot 'Unreachable' report karta hai aur ek hop 'NSG rule blocked' dikhata hai. Aage kya?
opts: Effective security rules review karein aur dikhaya gaya NSG rule badlein
Destination VM restart karein aur Connection troubleshoot dobara chalayen
D5-108.exp: Connection troubleshoot ne dhoond liya hai ke NSG rule raasta block kar raha hai aur dikhata hai kaun sa rule. Aage us NIC ya subnet ke effective security rules review karein aur traffic allow karne ke liye rule badlein ya add karein. VM restart, disks badalna ya VNet delete karna NSG rules par asar nahi dalta.

D5-109.q: Connection Monitor analysis aur alerting ke liye apne nateeje kahan store karta hai?
D5-109.exp: Connection Monitor apne test nateeje Log Analytics workspace mein store karta hai, jahan aap unhein KQL se query kar sakte hain. Yeh metrics bhi publish karta hai (jaise round-trip time aur checks failed %) jo aap alerts mein use kar sakte hain. Yeh nateejon ke liye Activity log ya Key Vault use nahi karta.

D5-110.q: Connection Monitor ko on-premises server se Azure VM tak test karna hai. On-premises server par kya chahiye?
opts: Azure Monitor Agent (ya supported monitoring agent) wala Azure Arc-enabled server
Network Watcher VM extension, sath mein public IP aur inbound NSG rule
D5-110.exp: Connection Monitor ko ghair-Azure sources par agent chahiye. On-premises server ke liye usay Azure Arc par onboard karein aur Azure Monitor Agent install karein taa ke woh tests chala sake. Network Watcher VM extension sirf Azure VMs ke liye hai, aur akela public IP tests nahi chalata.

D5-111.q: Connection Monitor mein test group kya hai?
opts: Sources, destinations aur test configurations (protocol, port, frequency) ka set jo ek sath evaluate hota hai
Resource group jis mein sources aur destinations hon, aur un ke alerts ka ek action group
D5-111.exp: Connection Monitor mein test group sources, destinations aur test configurations (protocol, port, test frequency aur thresholds) ko milata hai, aur us ke tamam tests ek sath evaluate hote hain. Yeh resource group, action group ya NSG nahi.

D5-112.q: Waqt ke sath do VMs ke darmiyan latency 50 ms se zyada hone par aap ko alert chahiye. Kaun sa tool?
opts: Round-trip time par metric alert ke sath Connection Monitor
Har minute scheduled IP flow verify, log alert ke sath
D5-112.exp: Connection Monitor endpoints ke darmiyan round-trip time aur checks failed musalsal napta hai, aur aap round-trip time 50 ms se upar jane par metric alert bana sakte hain. IP flow verify, next hop aur topology ek baar ke checks hain jo waqt ke sath latency nahi napte.

D5-113.q: Flow log record mein kya maloomat hoti hai?
opts: Source/destination IP aur port, protocol, allowed ya denied, aur bytes/packets
Poore packet payloads, TLS certificates, DNS queries aur process ka naam
D5-113.exp: Flow logs har flow ka metadata record karte hain: source aur destination IP aur port, protocol, direction, traffic allowed tha ya denied, aur (version 2 mein) bytes aur packets. In mein kabhi packets ka content nahi hota — us ke liye packet capture use karein. Yeh DNS queries ya CPU usage record nahi karte.

D5-114.q: Kaun sa feature flow logs se top talkers, malicious IPs aur traffic hotspots pehchanta hai?
D5-114.exp: Traffic Analytics flow logs ko Log Analytics workspace mein process karta hai aur geography aur threat intelligence add karta hai, is liye top talkers, traffic hotspots, malicious IPs aur khule ports dikha sakta hai. Packet capture raw packets record karta hai, IP flow verify ek flow test karta hai, aur VM insights VMs monitor karta hai.

D5-115.q: Traffic Analytics kaun se processing interval options deta hai?
opts: Din mein ek baar ya hafte mein ek baar
D5-115.exp: Traffic Analytics default mein har 60 minute flow log data process karta hai, ya tez insights ke liye har 10 minute (zyada cost par). Yeh har second, rozana ya haftawar process nahi karta.

D5-116.q: Kaun se DO Network Watcher tools NSG maslon mein madad karte hain?
D5-116.exp: IP flow verify batata hai ke makhsoos flow allowed hai ya denied aur kis NSG rule ne faisla kiya. Effective security rules NIC par lagne wale har NSG (subnet NSG plus NIC NSG) ke mile hue rules dikhate hain. VPN troubleshoot gateways check karta hai, aur packet capture rules samjhaye baghair traffic record karta hai.

D5-117.q: Ek VM web server tak nahi pohanch sakti. Network Watcher se samajhdar diagnosis ki tarteeb lagayen:
items: Routing path ke liye Next hop check karein
Destination tak Connection troubleshoot chalayen
NSG rules check karne ke liye IP flow verify chalayen
Agar masla ab bhi wazeh na ho to packet capture chalayen
D5-117.exp: Masla confirm karne aur dekhne ke liye ke raasta kahan fail hota hai, Connection troubleshoot se shuru karein. Phir NSG rules check karne ke liye IP flow verify, aur routing check karne ke liye next hop use karein. Sirf agar phir bhi wazeh na ho to asal traffic dekhne ke liye packet capture chalayen, jise analyse karne mein sab se zyada mehnat lagti hai.

D5-118.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: VPN troubleshoot virtual network gateway aur us ke connections diagnose kar sakta hai
IP flow verify do PaaS services ke darmiyan traffic ke liye kaam karta hai
Topology ko chalti VM chahiye
Network Watcher un resources ke region mein mojood hona chahiye jinhein aap diagnose karte hain
D5-118.exp: VPN troubleshoot virtual network gateway aur us ke connections diagnose karta hai. IP flow verify VM NICs par kaam karta hai, do PaaS services ke darmiyan traffic par nahi. Topology network resources dikhata hai aur chalti VM nahi chahiye. Network Watcher un resources ke region mein enabled hona chahiye jinhein aap diagnose karte hain.

D5-119.q: Kaun si CLI command Recovery Services vault banati hai?
opts: az backup vault create -g RG1 -n rsv1 -l westeurope
az recovery vault create -g RG1 -n rsv1 --region westeurope
D5-119.exp: az backup vault create -g, -n aur -l (location) ke sath Recovery Services vault banati hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi. Yaad rakhein ke VM backups ke liye vault VMs wale region mein hona chahiye.

D5-120.q: Kaun si CLI command DefaultPolicy ke sath VM1 ka backup enable karti hai?
opts: az backup protection enable-for-vm -g RG1 -v rsv1 --vm VM1 --policy-name DefaultPolicy
az backup vm add-protection -g RG1 --target-vault rsv1 --name VM1 --default-policy true
D5-120.exp: az backup protection enable-for-vm VM ko vault ki backup policy se associate karti hai: -v vault hai, --vm VM aur --policy-name policy (yahan DefaultPolicy). Phir pehla backup policy ke schedule par chalta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D5-121.q: Kaun si CLI command on-demand backup trigger karti hai?
D5-121.exp: az backup protection backup-now protected item ka schedule se bahar on-demand backup leti hai, aur --retain-until set karta hai ke woh recovery point kitne arse rakha jaye. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D5-122.q: Kaun sa vault security feature protection rok kar backup data delete karne jaise critical operations se pehle doosre user ki approval (Resource Guard ke zariye) mangta hai?
D5-122.exp: Multi-user authorization (MUA) Resource Guard use karta hai, jo aam tor par alag team ya tenant ki milkiyat hota hai, is liye critical vault operations — jaise backup data delete karna ya retention kam karna — ko us doosre shakhs ki approval chahiye. Soft delete delete hua data 14 din rakhta hai, immutability waqt se pehle deletion rokti hai, aur private endpoints network access mehfooz karte hain.

D5-123.q: Kaun si vault setting kisi ko bhi, admins samet, recovery points expire hone se pehle delete karne se rokti hai (ransomware ke khilaf)?
D5-123.exp: Immutable vault woh operations block karta hai jin se backup data kho sakta hai, jaise expire hone se pehle recovery points delete karna ya retention kam karna. Lock hone ke baad immutability band nahi ho sakti, admins bhi nahi kar sakte, jo ransomware se bachata hai. Soft delete undo ho sakta hai, aur CRR aur GRS redundancy ke bare mein hain.

D5-124.q: Kaun se roles user ko backups manage karne dete hain lekin vault delete karne ya access dene NAHI dete?
D5-124.exp: Backup Contributor backups aur restores bana aur manage kar sakta hai, lekin vault delete nahi kar sakta ya doosre users ko access nahi de sakta. Owner sab kuch kar sakta hai, access dena samet, User Access Administrator access manage karta hai, aur Reader sirf dekh sakta hai.

D5-125.q: Kya Recovery Services vault ko doosri subscription mein move kar sakte hain?
opts: Haan, resource groups aur subscriptions ke aar paar vault moves supported hain
Sirf agar vault khaali ho aur LRS redundancy se bana ho
D5-125.exp: Aap Recovery Services vault ko doosre resource group ya subscription mein move kar sakte hain, lekin kuch pabandiyan lagti hain — maslan aap usay doosre region mein move nahi kar sakte, aur kuch workloads ki shartein hain. Is liye yeh 'kabhi nahi' nahi, aur vault ka khali hona zaroori nahi.

D5-126.q: Backup data vault mein aap ki apni key se encrypt hona chahiye. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: Recovery Services vault ke liye customer-managed keys
Cache storage account par infrastructure encryption
D5-126.exp: Recovery Services vault backup data ko Key Vault mein rakhi customer-managed key se encrypt kar sakta hai, jise vault apni managed identity ke zariye parhta hai. Vault mein items protect karne se pehle yeh set up karein. Storage encryption settings aur Azure Disk Encryption yeh nahi badalte ke vault apna data kaise encrypt karta hai.

D5-127.q: Azure Backup VM par kaun sa extension install karta hai?
opts: AMA extension ke sath Dependency agent
D5-127.exp: Azure VM backup snapshots lene ke liye VM agent ke zariye VMSnapshot extension (Linux par VMSnapshotLinux) install karta hai. MARS agent poori Azure VM backups ke liye use nahi hota — yeh files aur folders ke liye hai. Dependency agent VM insights ke liye hai, aur ADE extension disk encryption handle karta hai.

D5-128.q: VSS-aware apps chalane wali Windows VMs ke sath Azure Backup kis consistency ka maqsad rakhta hai?
D5-128.exp: Windows par Azure Backup Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) use kar ke application-consistent snapshots leta hai, is liye SQL Server jaisi apps consistent halat mein hoti hain. Linux par isi asar ke liye aap pre- aur post-scripts add karte hain. Crash-consistent fallback hai, maqsad nahi.

D5-129.q: Azure VM ka backup application-consistent ke bajaye crash-consistent hai. Mumkin wajah?
opts: Backup ke dauran VM band thi, ya VSS fail hua
Vault GRS use karta hai, ya VM mein Premium SSD hai
D5-129.exp: Agar backup ke dauran VM band thi, ya VSS fail hua (maslan VSS writer error ki wajah se), to Azure Backup sirf crash-consistent snapshot le sakta hai. Vault redundancy, disk type aur tags consistency par asar nahi dalte.

D5-130.q: Kya VM ka pehla backup full hota hai ya incremental?
opts: Full, phir us ke baad incremental
Full, aur baad ki har backup bhi
D5-130.exp: VM ka pehla backup tamam data copy karta hai (full). Us ke baad har backup incremental hota hai: sirf pichle backup ke baad badle blocks transfer aur store hote hain, jo waqt aur storage bachata hai. Yeh hamesha full, shuru se hamesha incremental, ya differential nahi.

D5-131.q: Trusted Launch VMs ke liye kaun sa policy type zaroori hai aur hourly backups support karta hai?
D5-131.exp: Enhanced VM backup policy Trusted Launch VMs aur doosre naye features ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh din mein kai backups (har 4, 6, 8 ya 12 ghante), lambi instant-restore retention aur zone-resilient snapshots support karti hai. Standard policy din mein sirf ek backup leti hai. Is ke liye MARS aur archive policies mojood nahi.

D5-132.q: Ek VM ki 4 data disks hain, lekin sirf OS disk aur disk 1 ko protection chahiye. Kya yeh mumkin hai?
opts: Haan — selective disk backup disks exclude karne deta hai
Nahi — VM backup mein hamesha tamam disks hoti hain
D5-132.exp: Selective disk backup aap ko chunne deta hai ke kaun si data disks shamil hon (OS disk hamesha shamil hoti hai), is liye aap sirf OS disk aur disk 1 protect kar ke kam paise de sakte hain. Yeh Windows aur Linux ke liye chalta hai aur MARS nahi chahiye.

D5-133.q: Lambe arse ke monthly aur yearly VM recovery points khud saste tier mein jane chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D5-133.exp: Azure Backup ka apna archive tier hai: eligible long-term recovery points (monthly aur yearly) backup policy ke zariye, ya Azure ke recommend karne par, khud wahan ja sakte hain aur kahin saste hote hain. Blob lifecycle rules aap ke apne blobs par kaam karti hain, backup data par nahi, aur soft delete aur immutability tiers nahi badalte.

D5-134.q: VM ka backup kahan se enable kar sakte hain?
opts: VM ke Backup blade se ya vault se
Azure Advisor ya Activity log se
D5-134.exp: Aap khud VM (us ka Backup blade) se ya vault (Backup → Azure virtual machine) se backup enable kar sakte hain. Dono ka nateeja ek hai, aur aap CLI, PowerShell ya Azure Policy bhi use kar sakte hain. Yeh ek entry point tak mehdood nahi.

D5-135.q: Aap 'Create new VM' option se VM restore karte hain. Kya zaroori hai?
opts: Target VNet ke region mein naya vault
D5-135.exp: 'Create new VM' ko jaanna hota hai ke restore hui VM kahan rakhni hai — target resource group, VNet aur subnet — aur kuch restores ke liye usi region mein staging storage account. Naya vault nahi chahiye, aur VM usi region mein restore hoti hai jab tak cross-region restore use na karein.

D5-136.q: Kaun sa restore option mojooda VM ki configuration (NICs, IP) rakhta hai aur sirf disks ko recovery point se badalta hai?
D5-136.exp: 'Replace existing' VM ko us ke NICs, IP aur configuration ke sath rakhta hai, aur us ki disks ko recovery point wali disks se badal deta hai. Azure pehle mojooda disks ka snapshot leta hai, taa ke aap wapas ja sakein. 'Create new VM' doosri VM banata hai, aur 'Restore disks' sirf disks banata hai.

D5-137.q: Aap ko template use kar ke custom settings (alag size, extra NIC) ke sath VM restore karni hai. Kaun sa option?
opts: Restore disks, phir bane hue template ko customize kar ke deploy karein
Mojooda disks replace karein, phir VM resize kar ke extra NIC lagayen
D5-137.exp: 'Restore disks' disks plus VM ka template banata hai. Aap template edit kar sakte hain — maslan alag size ya extra NIC — aur deploy kar sakte hain. 'Create new VM' aur 'Replace existing' fixed settings use karte hain, aur file recovery sirf files restore karti hai.

D5-138.q: File recovery script chalane ke baad default mein recovery point kitni der mounted rehta hai?
opts: 7 din (phir script dobara chalana parta hai)
D5-138.exp: File recovery script chalane ke baad recovery point 12 ghante tak drives ke taur par mounted rehta hai, phir khud unmount ho jata hai. Files copy karne ke baad aap portal se pehle bhi unmount kar sakte hain.

D5-139.q: Azure VM mein SQL Server ko point-in-time restore ke sath har 15 minute log backups chahiye. Kaun sa hal?
opts: Azure VMs mein SQL Server ka Azure Backup
Enhanced policy ke sath VM backup
D5-139.exp: Azure VMs mein SQL Server ka Azure Backup Recovery Services vault mein workload-aware backup hai. Yeh full aur differential backups plus har 15 minute tak log backups support karta hai, is liye aap makhsoos point-in-time par restore kar sakte hain. VM-level backup database ko point-in-time par restore nahi kar sakta, aur MARS files ka backup leta hai.

D5-140.q: On-premises server ke MARS agent ko vault mein register karne ke liye kya chahiye?
opts: Vault se download ki gayi vault credentials file
Vault ki storage par bana SAS token
D5-140.exp: Vault se vault credentials file download karein (yeh mehdood waqt, aam tor par 10 din, ke liye valid hoti hai) aur MARS setup ke dauran server ko us vault mein register karne ke liye use karein. Aap encryption passphrase bhi set karte hain. SSH keys, SAS tokens aur Entra licences use nahi hote.

D5-141.q: MARS setup ke dauran aap encryption passphrase set karte hain. Agar woh kho jaye to kya hota hai?
opts: Microsoft usay wapas nahi la sakta, is liye aap data restore nahi kar sakte
Microsoft subscription owner ki tasdeeq ke baad reset kar deta hai
Aap us ke baghair restore karte hain
D5-141.exp: MARS passphrase aap ke backups ko server se nikalne se pehle encrypt karta hai, aur Microsoft usay kabhi nahi dekhta. Agar yeh kho jaye to koi backups decrypt nahi kar sakta, is liye aap restore nahi kar sakte. Isay mehfooz jagah rakhein, maslan Azure Key Vault mein.

D5-142.q: On-premises Hyper-V VMs aur SQL Server ko Azure mein app-aware backups chahiye. Kaun sa hal?
opts: Microsoft Azure Backup Server (MABS) ya System Center DPM, vault ko offsite storage ke taur par
Har Hyper-V host par MARS agent, app-aware mode on aur vault bator storage
D5-142.exp: Microsoft Azure Backup Server (MABS) ya System Center DPM on-premises apps jaise Hyper-V VMs aur SQL Server ka application-aware tareeqe se pehle local disk par backup lete hain, phir offsite storage ke liye copies Recovery Services vault ko bhejte hain. MARS sirf files ka backup leta hai, ASR disaster recovery hai, aur AzCopy sirf data copy karta hai.

D5-143.q: Managed disks ko VM backup extension ke baghair, snapshot-based restore ke sath, din mein kai baar backups chahiye. Kaun sa hal?
opts: Backup vault mein Azure Disk Backup
D5-143.exp: Backup vault mein configure kiya Azure Disk Backup baghair agent ya extension ke managed disks ke incremental snapshots leta hai, zaroorat ho to din mein kai baar, aur unhi snapshots se restore karta hai. Recovery Services VM backup VM extension use karta hai, MARS files ke liye hai, aur blob versioning blobs ke liye.

D5-144.q: Kaun sa Azure Backup option blobs ko storage account mein locally (vault copy ke baghair) musalsal point-in-time recovery ke sath protect karta hai?
opts: Azure Blobs ke liye operational backup
D5-144.exp: Azure Blobs ka operational backup data ko khud storage account mein rakhta hai, point-in-time restore, versioning aur soft delete jaise features use karte hue, is liye aap kisi bhi point par musalsal restore kar sakte hain. Vaulted backup blobs ko Backup vault mein copy karta hai. MARS aur VM backup blobs protect nahi karte.

D5-145.q: Backup reports (vaults ke aar paar usage, jobs, policies) ko kya chahiye?
opts: Vaults par Log Analytics workspace ko data bhejne wali diagnostic settings
Har vault ka storage account aur un sab par Reports Reader role
D5-145.exp: Backup reports Log Analytics ke data par bani hain, is liye har vault ko aisi diagnostic setting chahiye jo us ka backup data workspace mein bheje. Phir reports vaults ke aar paar jobs, usage aur policies dikhati hain. Is ke baghair reports ke paas dikhane ko kuch nahi.

D5-146.q: Aap recommended Azure Monitor tareeqe se backup jobs fail hone par email notifications chahte hain. Kya use karein?
opts: Backup ke Azure Monitor-based built-in alerts, alert processing rules aur action groups se route kiye gaye
Classic vault email notifications, jo vault properties mein likhe co-administrators ko jayen
D5-146.exp: Azure Backup ab Azure Monitor mein built-in alerts uthata hai (maslan failed backup jobs ke liye). Aap unhein alert processing rule plus action group ke zariye logon tak pohanchate hain. Classic vault email alerts retire ho rahe hain, aur Advisor aur budgets job failures report nahi karte.

D5-147.q: Vault ke backup jobs ka status (completed, failed, in progress) kahan dekh sakte hain?
D5-147.exp: Har vault ka Backup jobs page completed, failed aur chalte jobs dikhata hai, aur Resiliency (Azure Business Continuity Center) tamam vaults ke jobs dikhata hai. Activity log Azure operations dikhata hai, job details nahi, aur metrics aur VM insights backup jobs track nahi karte.

D5-148.q: VM backup policy kaun si DO cheezein define kar sakti hai?
opts: Rozana backup ka waqt aur frequency
D5-148.exp: VM backup policy schedule — backups kab aur kitni baar chalein — aur retention define karti hai: daily, weekly, monthly aur yearly recovery points kitne arse rahein. Yeh restore ke baad VM ka size ya koi NSG rules define nahi karti.

D5-149.q: Aap backup policy ki daily retention 30 se 10 din karte hain. Mojooda recovery points ka kya hota hai?
opts: Mojooda points nayi retention ke mutabiq chalte hain, is liye 10 din se purane points saaf ho jate hain
Mojooda points purane 30 din rakhte hain, aur sirf naye points 10 din ki retention follow karte hain
Sab foran delete ho jate hain
Kuch nahi; sirf nayi VMs par asar hota hai
D5-149.exp: Backup policy mein retention badalna mojooda recovery points par bhi apply hota hai. Jab daily retention 30 se 10 din hoti hai to 10 din se purane points saaf ho jate hain (jab tak woh weekly, monthly ya yearly points ke taur par bhi na rakhe gaye hon). Is liye retention kam karne se pehle asar check karein.

D5-150.ctx: Vault RSV1 (West Europe, GRS, CRR enabled, soft delete on) VM1 (West Europe) ko Standard daily policy se protect karta hai: 30 daily, 12 monthly.
D5-150.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: VM1 kisi bhi waqt North Europe (paired region) mein restore ho sakti hai
RSV1 East US mein mojood VM2 ko bhi protect kar sakta hai
Agar koi protection band kar ke data delete kare to woh 14 din ke andar wapas mil sakta hai
Aap RSV1 ko ab bhi LRS kar sakte hain kyun ke VM1 pehle se protected hai
D5-150.exp: GRS aur cross-region restore ke sath VM1 kisi bhi waqt paired region (North Europe) mein restore ho sakti hai. Vault sirf apne region ki VMs protect kar sakta hai, is liye East US ki VM2 nahi. Soft delete delete hua backup data 14 din rakhta hai. Pehla item protect hote hi redundancy lock ho jati hai, is liye RSV1 ab LRS nahi ho sakta.

D5-151.q: Azure Site Recovery kaun sa vault type use karta hai?
D5-151.exp: Azure Site Recovery Recovery Services vault mein configure hota hai, wahi vault type jo VM backup ke liye use hota hai. Backup vaults disks aur blobs jaise naye workloads ke liye hain, aur Key Vault aur storage accounts ASR ke vaults nahi.

D5-152.q: Azure-to-Azure disaster recovery ke liye Recovery Services vault kahan hona chahiye?
opts: TARGET (recovery) region mein, source region mein nahi
SOURCE region mein, replicate hone wali VMs ke sath
D5-152.exp: Azure-to-Azure disaster recovery ke liye Recovery Services vault target (recovery) region mein rakhein. Agar source region fail ho to vault aur us ki settings failover chalane ke liye available rehti hain. Source region ka vault us ke sath band ho sakta hai.

D5-153.q: Vault region ke rules ka muqabla karein: Azure Backup bamuqabla ASR (Azure-to-Azure).
opts: Backup: VM wale HI region mein vault; ASR: TARGET region mein vault
Backup: vault TARGET region mein; ASR: vault VM wale region mein
D5-153.exp: Yeh exam ka aam trap hai. Azure Backup ko Recovery Services vault un VMs wale region mein chahiye jinhein woh protect karta hai. Azure Site Recovery (Azure to Azure) ko vault target region mein chahiye, taa ke source region ke outage se bach jaye.

D5-154.q: Replication enable karne par ASR target region mein kya banata hai?
opts: Resource group, VNet aur replica managed disks
Vault se failover shuru hone tak kuch nahi
D5-154.exp: Replication enable karne par ASR target region mein target resource group, target VNet (ya aap ke chune VNet se mapping) aur replica managed disks set up karta hai, sath mein source region mein cache storage account. Replication foran shuru hoti hai; failover ka intezar nahi karti.

D5-155.q: ASR source VMs ke changes ko target region bhejne se pehle waqti tor par kahan store karta hai?
opts: SOURCE region ke cache storage account mein
Har TARGET VM se lagi cache disk
D5-155.exp: ASR pehle VM disk changes ko source region ke cache storage account mein likhta hai, phir unhein target region ki replica disks ko bhejta hai. Changes seedha vault mein nahi jate, aur Key Vault aur Log Analytics shamil nahi.

D5-156.q: ASR mein recovery point kya hai?
opts: Replicated VM ki point-in-time halat jis par aap fail over kar sakte hain
Backup policy ki setting jo tay kare ke replicas kitni der rahein
D5-156.exp: Recovery point replicated VM ki kisi waqt ki halat ki copy hai jis par aap fail over kar sakte hain. Yeh crash-consistent (har 5 minute liya jata hai) ya app-consistent (aap ke set kiye waqfe par) ho sakta hai. Replication policy control karti hai ke yeh kitne arse rakhe jayen.

D5-157.q: ASR Azure VMs ke crash-consistent recovery points kitni baar banata hai?
D5-157.exp: Azure VMs ke liye ASR har 5 minute crash-consistent recovery point banata hai. App-consistent points kam baar bante hain, aap ke ghanton mein configure kiye waqfe par. Yeh hourly, daily ya weekly nahi.

D5-158.q: Jab primary region asal mein band ho to kaun sa failover type use karte hain?
D5-158.exp: Jab primary region sach mein band ho to recovery point se target region mein VMs chalane ke liye unplanned failover chalayen. Test failover sirf drills ke liye hai, cleanup test VMs hatata hai, aur planned failover tab tarteeb se move ke liye hai jab source ab bhi theek ho aur data loss na ho.

D5-159.q: Mukammal ASR DR cycle ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Secondary region mein fail over karein
Target region mein replication enable karein
Original region ki taraf re-protect karein (replication ulti)
Primary region mein fail back karein
D5-159.exp: Pehle target region mein replication enable karein. Aafat mein secondary region mein fail over karein. Phir re-protect karein, jo replication ulti karta hai taa ke secondary wapas original region mein replicate kare. Aakhir mein primary region theek hone par wahan fail back karein (aur dobara re-protect karein).

D5-160.q: Test failover validate hone ke baad aap kya karte hain?
opts: Test VMs delete karne ke liye 'Cleanup test failover' chalayen
'Commit' chalayen taa ke test VMs naye replicas ban jayen
D5-160.exp: Test VMs check karne ke baad test VMs aur jure resources delete karne ke liye 'Cleanup test failover' chalayen. Commit asli failovers par apply hota hai, replication disable karna protection rokta hai, aur vault delete karna sab kuch hata deta hai.

D5-161.q: Asli failover ke baad 'Commit' kya karta hai?
D5-161.exp: Asli failover ke baad Commit usay pakka karta hai: aap ab doosre recovery point par nahi ja sakte. Yeh replication shuru nahi karta (woh re-protect hai), source VMs delete nahi karta, ya failover cancel nahi karta.

D5-162.q: DR drill ke liye test-failover VMs ko kaun se network se jurna chahiye?
opts: Target region mein isolated VNet, production se jura hua nahi
Target region ka production VNet, usi IP ranges ke sath
D5-162.exp: Test-failover VMs ko target region ke aise isolated VNet se jurna chahiye jo production se jura na ho. Warna ek jaise naam aur IPs wali duplicate VMs production se takra sakti hain. VMs ko phir bhi network chahiye, aur source VNet doosre region mein hai.

D5-163.q: Failover options kaun sa recovery point chunne dete hain?
opts: Latest (sab se kam RPO), Latest processed (sab se kam RTO), Latest app-consistent, ya custom point
Sirf latest crash-consistent point, ya sab se purana point jo abhi maujood ho
D5-163.exp: Failover aap ko recovery point chunne deta hai: Latest (sab se kam data loss ke liye tamam pending data process karta hai), Latest processed (sab se tez), Latest app-consistent (apps consistent hoti hain), ya custom point. Yeh RPO aur RTO ke darmiyan sauda hai, ek fixed option nahi.

D5-164.q: Kaun sa option sab se tez failover (sab se kam RTO) deta hai?
D5-164.exp: Latest processed us sab se naye recovery point par fail over karta hai jo ASR pehle hi process kar chuka, is liye pending data process hone ka intezar nahi karta. Is se sab se tez failover (sab se kam RTO) milta hai. Latest mein data loss kam hai lekin waqt zyada lagta hai, aur app-consistent points purane hote hain.

D5-165.q: Machine groups ke ilawa recovery plan mein kya shamil ho sakta hai?
opts: Pre/post scripts, Azure Automation runbooks, aur manual actions
Azure Policy assignments, budgets aur resource locks
D5-165.exp: Machines ke tarteeb-war groups ke ilawa recovery plan pre- aur post-scripts, Azure Automation runbooks (maslan DNS ya load balancer update karne ke liye), aur manual actions chala sakta hai jo kisi ke confirm karne tak rukte hain. Budgets, policies aur locks recovery plan ka hissa nahi.

D5-166.q: Kai VMs ko ek shared, consistent recovery point par fail over hona hai (maslan multi-VM apps). Kaun si setting?
D5-166.exp: Multi-VM consistency VMs ko replication group mein dalti hai, is liye woh crash-consistent aur app-consistent recovery points share karti hain aur ek hi lamhe par fail over hoti hain — multi-tier apps ke liye ahem. Recovery plans tarteeb control karte hain, consistency nahi, aur backup policies backup ke liye hain.

D5-167.q: Kya ASR on-premises VMware VMs aur physical servers ko Azure mein replicate kar sakta hai?
opts: Haan — ASR VMware, Hyper-V aur physical servers ko Azure tak support karta hai
Sirf Hyper-V — VMware VMs ko Azure Migrate aur Backup chahiye
D5-167.exp: ASR on-premises VMware VMs, Hyper-V VMs aur physical Windows ya Linux servers ko Azure mein replicate kar sakta hai, aur Azure VMs ko regions ke darmiyan bhi. Yeh Azure VMs, Hyper-V ya Linux tak mehdood nahi.

D5-168.q: Replicated VMs ko target region ke makhsoos availability zone mein chalna chahiye. Kya yeh configurable hai?
opts: Haan — replication settings mein target availability zones ya sets chun sakte hain
Nahi — failover shuru hone par target zone hamesha Azure chunta hai
D5-168.exp: Replication enable karte waqt aap target settings chun sakte hain jaise availability zone ya availability set jo replicated VM target region mein use kare. Is liye failover ke baad VM aap ke chahe zone mein chalti hai. Yeh Windows aur Linux ke liye chalta hai aur failover se pehle set hota hai.

D5-169.q: Kya ASR VMs ko USI region ke availability zones ke darmiyan replicate kar sakta hai?
opts: Haan — bohat se regions mein zone-to-zone disaster recovery supported hai
Nahi — ASR VMs ko sirf do paired regions ke darmiyan replicate karta hai
D5-169.exp: Haan. ASR zone-to-zone disaster recovery support karta hai, VMs ko usi region ke ek availability zone se doosre mein replicate karta hai, bohat se regions mein. Is ke liye Azure Backup nahi chahiye, aur yeh sirf VM scale sets ke liye nahi.

D5-170.q: DNS ke sath failover ke baad web apps ka RTO kam rakhne mein ASR kaise madad karta hai?
opts: Recovery plan scripts ya Traffic Manager se users ko failed-over endpoints par redirect karein
Failover ke dauran source VM ka public IP address target region mein le jayen
D5-170.exp: ASR VMs ko target region mein chala deta hai, lekin users ko bhi un tak pohanchna hota hai. DNS update karne ke liye recovery plan scripts ya runbooks use karein, ya users ko khud failed-over endpoints par bhejne ke liye Traffic Manager priority routing. Kuch na karne se users fail hue region ki taraf hi rehte hain, aur NSGs aur Advisor traffic redirect nahi karte.

D5-171.q: Kaun sa ASR metric dikhata hai ke replicated data kitna taaza hai?
opts: RPO (har VM ki replication health aur RPO values)
Disk IOPS (har VM ka average read aur write)
D5-171.exp: Har replicated item apni replication health aur mojooda RPO dikhata hai — replica source se kitna peeche hai — is liye aap dekh sakte hain ke data kitna taaza hai. CPU aur IOPS performance metrics hain, aur cost replication ka paimana nahi.

D5-172.q: Azure-to-Azure replication ki kaun si DO prerequisites hain?
opts: Source VMs se zaroori Azure service endpoints/URLs (ya service tags) tak outbound connectivity
Sab se naya Mobility service, jo extension ke taur par khud install hota hai
D5-172.exp: Source VMs ko Azure Site Recovery service URLs ya service tags tak outbound connectivity chahiye (maslan NSG ya proxy ke zariye). Mobility service replication enable karne par VM extension ke taur par khud install hoti hai aur updated rakhi jati hai. MARS aur ExpressRoute ki zaroorat nahi.

D5-173.q: ASR ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Test failover jari replication par asar dalta hai
Re-protect failover ke baad replication ki direction ulti karta hai
ASR VMs ko regions ke darmiyan migrate karne ke liye use ho sakta hai
ASR replication ka charge har protected instance par hota hai
D5-173.exp: Test failover isolated network mein chalta hai aur jari replication nahi rokta. Re-protect failover ke baad replication ki direction ulti karta hai. ASR VMs ko regions ke darmiyan migrate bhi kar sakta hai. Is ka bill har protected instance par, sath mein target region mein use hone wali storage par, hota hai.

D5-174.q: Ransomware ne 3 din pehle VM ki files encrypt kin aur woh replicate ho gayin. Kaun si service saaf data wapas lati hai?
D5-174.exp: ASR changes minton mein replicate karta hai, is liye encrypted files pehle hi us ke haal ke recovery points mein hain (aur yeh points zyada arse nahi rakhta). Azure Backup purane recovery points rakhta hai, is liye aap attack se pehle wala restore kar sakte hain. Isi liye backups ransomware se aap ki hifazat hain.

D5-175.q: Ek app ko regional outage ke minton ke andar, kam se kam data loss ke sath, doosre region mein chalna hai. Kaun si service?
D5-175.exp: Azure Site Recovery doosre region mein up-to-date replica rakhta hai, is liye app minton mein (kam RTO) sirf chand minute ke data loss (kam RPO) ke sath fail over ho sakti hai. Azure Backup se restore kahin slow hai. Blob versioning aur templates chalti VMs replicate nahi karte.

D5-176.q: ASR ke bajaye Azure Backup ke kaun se DO aam istemal hain?
opts: Compliance ke liye long-term retention (maslan 10 saal ke yearly points)
Ghalti se delete hui files wapas lana
Recovery plans ke sath orchestrated regional failover
D5-176.exp: Azure Backup long-term retention (maslan 10 saal rakhe jane wale yearly points) aur ek delete hui file ya folder restore karne ka tool hai. Recovery plans ke sath orchestrated regional failover, aur 5-minute RPO ke sath musalsal replication, ASR ke features hain.

D5-177.q: Kaun sa vault type Azure file shares protect karta hai?
D5-177.exp: Azure file share backup Recovery Services vault mein configure hota hai. Backup vaults disks, blobs aur PostgreSQL handle karte hain, Key Vault secrets rakhta hai, aur file shares protect ho sakte hain, is liye 'Koi nahi' ghalat hai.

D5-178.q: Kya Azure file share backup se individual files restore kar sakte hain?
opts: Haan — poore share ka aur item-level restore, dono
Nahi — sirf poora share, usi account mein
D5-178.exp: Azure file share backup se aap poora share ya sirf makhsoos files aur folders restore kar sakte hain, asal location par ya kisi aur par. MARS shamil nahi, aur restores Azure file shares par jate hain, on-premises par nahi.

D5-179.q: Jab Azure Backup file share protect karta hai to storage account mein kaun si hifazat add karta hai?
opts: Account ko ghalti se delete hone se rokne wala resource lock
Account ke har share par immutability policy
D5-179.exp: File share protect karne par Azure Backup storage account par delete lock add karta hai taa ke koi usay ghalti se delete na kare — jis se backups bhi delete ho jate, kyun ke snapshots account mein rehte hain. Yeh immutable storage, private endpoints ya GRS enable nahi karta.

D5-180.q: Ops team ek dashboard chahti hai jo VM CPU, failed backups aur storage availability dikhaye. Behtareen tool?
opts: Metrics aur log queries milane wale Azure Monitor Workbooks (ya shared dashboard)
Metrics aur backups ke filters ke sath saved Activity log view
D5-180.exp: Azure Monitor Workbooks (ya shared dashboard) VM CPU aur storage availability jaise metrics ko failed backup jobs jaisi log queries ke sath team ke liye ek view mein mila sakte hain. Advisor recommendations deta hai, Activity log operations dikhata hai, aur Cost analysis kharcha dikhata hai.

D5-181.q: Jab bhi koi subscription scope par role assignment banaye to admin ko alert milna chahiye. Kaise?
opts: Subscription ke role assignment count par metric alert, threshold 1
D5-181.exp: Role assignment banana control-plane operation (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write) hai jo Activity log mein record hota hai. Subscription scope par us operation ka Activity log alert har baar fire hota hai. Metric alerts numbers dekhte hain, aur Advisor aur budgets role changes track nahi karte.

D5-182.q: Kaun si Azure Advisor category backup ke baghair VMs ko flag karti hai?
D5-182.exp: Azure Advisor ki Reliability category (pehle 'High availability') mein VMs par backup enable karne jaisi recommendations shamil hain. Cost, Performance aur Security doosre shobe cover karti hain.

D5-183.q: Aap ko check karna hai ke subscription ki har VM ka backup enabled hai, aur khud enable karna hai. Behtareen tareeqa?
opts: Azure Policy: DeployIfNotExists aur remediation ke sath 'Configure backup on VMs...'
Har VM par ReadOnly resource lock aur nakaam backups ka alert rule
D5-183.exp: Built-in Azure Policy definition ('Configure backup on virtual machines…') DeployIfNotExists use kar ke VMs par backup khud enable karti hai, aur remediation task mojooda VMs theek karta hai. Manual checks scale nahi hote, alerts sirf batate hain, aur locks sirf deletion rokte hain.

D5-184.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Alerts Recovery Services vault ke backup failures monitor kar sakte hain
Service Health alerts muft hain
Metric alert rules har monitor hone wali time series par bill hote hain
Log Analytics data ek query mein kai workspaces ke aar paar query ho sakta hai
D5-184.exp: Charon sahi hain. Backup failures Azure Monitor alerts uthate hain. Service Health alerts Activity log alerts hain aur muft hain. Metric alert rules har monitor hone wali time series par bill hote hain. Aur KQL workspace() function se ek sath kai workspaces query kar sakti hai.

D5-185.q: Kaun si KQL query pichle din ke failed Azure Backup jobs list karti hai (resource-specific tables)?
opts: AddonAzureBackupJobs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and JobStatus == "Failed"
AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and Category == "BackupFailed"
D5-185.exp: Resource-specific diagnostic tables ke sath backup job data AddonAzureBackupJobs mein jata hai, is liye usay pichle din aur JobStatus == "Failed" par filter karein. Heartbeat agent heartbeats rakhta hai, Perf performance counters, aur AzureActivity control-plane operations, backup job ke nateeje nahi.

D5-186.q: Disk ki khali jagah 10% se kam hone par alert trigger hona chahiye. Kaun sa signal source?
opts: Guest perf data (AMA ka collect kiya) par log search alert ya VM insights metric
VM ke OS Disk Free Space Percentage counter par platform metric alert
D5-186.exp: Khali disk space guest OS ke andar napi jati hai, is liye platform metrics mein shamil nahi. Isay Azure Monitor Agent se collect karein (maslan VM insights ke zariye) aur us performance data par log search alert lagayen. Activity log aur Service Health mein disk space data nahi hota.

D5-187.q: Kaun sa built-in feature ek click mein VM ke recommended alert rules deta hai?
D5-187.exp: VM ke Alerts page par aap ek step mein recommended alert rules enable kar sakte hain — CPU, available memory aur network jaise aam metric alerts — apne thresholds aur action group ke sath. Advisor recommendations deta hai, Policy rules enforce karti hai, aur Workbooks reports hain.

D5-188.q: Kaun si CLI command VM CPU > 80% ke liye metric alert banati hai?
opts: az monitor metrics alert create -g RG1 -n cpu80 --scopes <vmId> --condition "avg Percentage CPU > 80" --action ag1
az vm alert add -g RG1 -n cpu80 --vm <vmId> --metric "Percentage CPU" --greater-than 80 --notify ag1
D5-188.exp: az monitor metrics alert create scope (--scopes VM ki ID ke sath), condition ("avg Percentage CPU > 80") aur action group (--action) set karti hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi, aur az monitor log alerts log search queries ke liye hain.

D5-189.q: Kaun si CLI command email receiver wala action group banati hai?
opts: az monitor action-group create -g RG1 -n ag1 --action email ops ops@contoso.com
az monitor email create -g RG1 -n ag1 --receiver ops ops@contoso.com
D5-189.exp: az monitor action-group create action group banati hai, aur har --action ek receiver add karta hai: yahan type email, naam ops, address ops@contoso.com. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D5-190.q: SMS jaisi action group notifications par kaun si rate limits lagti hain?
opts: SMS aur voice notifications har number par rate-limited hain
Webhooks har action group par din mein ek call tak mehdood hain
D5-190.exp: Action groups ki har destination par rate limits hain: har phone number par har 5 minute mein 1 SMS aur 1 voice call se zyada nahi, aur har address par ghante mein 100 emails tak. Is liye alerts ke sailab mein notifications gir sakti hain. Webhooks din mein ek tak mehdood nahi.

D5-191.q: Autoscale settings, jo Azure Monitor ka feature hain, kin resources par apply hoti hain?
opts: VM scale sets, App Service plans, Cloud Services, aur kuch aur
Storage accounts, virtual networks, key vaults aur recovery vaults
D5-191.exp: Azure Monitor mein autoscale un resources par kaam karta hai jo instances add ya remove kar sakte hain, jaise VM scale sets, App Service plans aur Cloud Services (aur kuch aur, jaise API Management). Storage accounts, VNets aur Key Vault ke scale karne wale instances nahi.

D5-192.q: Jab bhi autoscale instances add ya remove kare to aap ko kaise bataya ja sakta hai?
opts: Autoscale setting mein email ya webhook notifications configure karein
Scale set ke region ka Service Health alert banayen
D5-192.exp: Autoscale setting mein aap har baar scale in ya out hone par email bhej ya webhook call kar sakte hain. Scale actions Activity log mein Autoscale category ke neeche bhi record hote hain, is liye aap un par alert laga sakte hain. Advisor aur Service Health scale actions report nahi karte.

D5-193.q: Kaun sa feature public website ki availability kai global locations se check karta hai?
D5-193.exp: Application Insights availability tests (standard tests) schedule par duniya bhar ki kai Azure locations se URL par requests bhejte hain aur fail ya slow hone par alert karte hain. IP flow verify aur connection troubleshoot aap ke network ke andar se test karte hain, aur Activity log operations record karta hai.

D5-194.q: Kaun sa insights experience Azure Kubernetes Service aur container workloads monitor karta hai?
D5-194.exp: Container insights AKS clusters (aur Arc-enabled Kubernetes) monitor karta hai: node aur pod performance, container logs aur cluster health. VM insights VMs monitor karta hai, Network insights networking cover karta hai, aur Storage insights storage accounts.

D5-195.q: 50 VMs se Windows event logs collect karne aur critical events par alert karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Action group ke sath Event table par log search alert banayen
Log Analytics workspace banayen
Windows event logs ke liye DCR bana kar VMs se associate karein (AMA installed)
KQL query se data validate karein
D5-195.exp: Pehle workspace chahiye, kyun ke data collection rule data usi ko bhejti hai. Phir Windows event logs ki DCR bana kar 50 VMs se associate karein (jis se AMA install hota hai). Phir KQL query chala kar confirm karein ke events aa rahe hain, aur aakhir mein action group ke sath Event table par log search alert banayen.

D5-196.q: Kya Azure Disk Encryption se encrypted VM ka backup le sakte hain?
opts: Haan — Azure Backup ADE VMs support karta hai
Nahi — ADE VMs sirf ASR se protect hoti hain
D5-196.exp: Azure Backup Windows aur Linux dono par Azure Disk Encryption se encrypted VMs support karta hai. Backup service ko Key Vault par permissions chahiye taa ke woh encrypted disks ke sath keys aur secrets ka bhi backup le sake. MARS ki zaroorat nahi. Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga: nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host use karein.

D5-197.q: VM ka backup 'UserErrorGuestAgentStatusUnavailable' ke sath fail hota hai. Pehle kya check karenge?
opts: Ke VM agent installed, chal raha aur up to date hai, aur VM Azure endpoints tak pohanch sakti hai
Ke NSG vault se inbound port 445 allow kare, aur vault GRS redundancy use kare
D5-197.exp: Azure VM backup VM agent ke zariye kaam karta hai, jo backup extension chalata hai. 'GuestAgentStatusUnavailable' ka matlab agent jawab nahi de raha, is liye check karein ke woh installed, chal raha aur up to date hai, aur VM Azure endpoints tak pohanch sakti hai. Storage tier, port 445 aur DNS zones wajah nahi.

D5-198.q: Asal ko chhue baghair pichle hafte ki VM ki test copy banane ke liye kaun sa restore type use karna chahiye?
D5-198.exp: 'Create new VM' recovery point ko alag VM ke taur par restore karta hai, is liye asal baghair badle chalti rehti hai. 'Replace existing' asal ki disks overwrite kar dega, aur test failover Site Recovery ka feature hai, backup restore nahi.

D5-199.ctx: North Europe mein critical app VM ki requirements: (1) rozana backups 7 saal rakhe jayen; (2) regional outage ke 30 minute ke andar West Europe mein failover; (3) baghair asar ke har teen mahine DR drills; (4) ek delete hue folder ka restore.
D5-199.q: Kaun sa combination TAMAM requirements poori karta hai?
opts: Azure Backup (daily policy plus yearly retention, file recovery) aur West Europe tak ASR (test failovers ke sath)
Sirf Azure Backup (cross-region restore wala GRS vault, instant restore snapshots aur yearly retention)
D5-199.exp: Azure Backup 7 saal rakhe jane wale rozana backups (yearly retention) aur ek folder restore (file-level recovery) cover karta hai. West Europe tak Azure Site Recovery 30 minute ke andar failover aur baghair asar ke quarterly drills (test failover) cover karta hai. Akela Backup bohat slow fail over karta hai, akela ASR 7 saal nahi rakh sakta ya files restore nahi kar sakta, aur blob features VMs protect nahi karte.

D5-200.ctx: Ops setup: LAW1 VM perf data (AMA/DCR) aur vault diagnostics leta hai. Alert rules: metric CPU > 90% (AG-Ops), AddonAzureBackupJobs failures par log alert (AG-Backup). Ek alert processing rule Saturday 00:00–04:00 notifications suppress karta hai.
D5-200.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Saturday 02:00 ka CPU spike phir bhi Azure Monitor mein fired alert banata hai
AG-Ops Saturday 02:00 ke us spike ke liye email bhejta hai
Backup job failures par Log Analytics ke zariye alert lagaya ja sakta hai
Vault diagnostic settings hatane se backup log alert toot jayega
D5-200.exp: Alert processing rule sirf actions suppress karta hai, is liye 02:00 ka CPU spike phir bhi fired alert banata hai, lekin window ke dauran AG-Ops email nahi bhejta. Backup job failures par Log Analytics mein log alert lagaya ja sakta hai, jo vault ki diagnostic settings par depend karta hai — unhein hatayen to backup alert ko data nahi milta.

D5-241.q: Public Azure regions mein Azure Backup vaults ke soft delete ke bare mein kya sahi hai?
opts: Admin ke enable karne tak band rehta hai
Yeh disable nahi ho sakta, aur retention 14 se 180 din hai
Yeh data 7 din rakhta hai aur disable ho sakta hai
Deletion ke pehle din se hi extra paisa lagta hai
D5-241.exp: Public regions mein Recovery Services vaults aur Backup vaults par soft delete default mein on hai aur disable nahi ho sakta. Retention default 14 din hai aur 14 se 180 din tak set ho sakti hai. Pehle 14 din free hain, us se zyada dinon ka paisa lagta hai.

D5-242.q: VM ke kaun se DO signals ke liye guest OS mein agent chahiye?
D5-242.exp: Percentage CPU aur Network In Total jaise host metrics platform metrics hain, jo khud ba khud aur free collect hote hain. Disk ki khaali jagah aur Windows event logs sirf guest OS ke andar hote hain, is liye unhein data collection rule ke sath Azure Monitor Agent chahiye.

D5-243.q: VM ka backup rozana 23:00 par hota hai. Agle din 20:00 par disk kharab hoti hai. Sirf backup se kitna data ja sakta hai?
opts: Kuch nahi, kyunke backup musalsal replicate karta hai
D5-243.exp: Aakhri recovery point 23:00 ka hai, aur kharabi 21 ghante baad, is liye un 21 ghanton ki tabdeeliyan jati hain. Kam nuqsan ke liye din mein kai backups wali Enhanced policy, ya musalsal replication ke liye Site Recovery.

D5-244.q: VM ko Azure Backup ke sath 4 ghante ka RPO chahiye. Kaun si policy?
opts: Har 4 ghante ke schedule wali Enhanced policy
5 din instant restore wali Standard policy
D5-244.exp: RPO backups ke darmiyan ka waqt hai, is liye har 4 ghante backup chahiye. Din mein kai backups sirf Enhanced policy deti hai, aur us ka sab se chota waqfa 4 ghante hai. Instant restore wapsi tez karta hai, backups nahi barhata.

D5-245.q: App zyada se zyada 15 minute ka data kho sakti hai aur regional outage ke 1 ghante mein dobara chalni chahiye. Kaun sa hal?
opts: GRS vault mein rozana VM backup, cross-region restore ke sath
Recovery plan ke sath doosre region tak Azure Site Recovery
Teen fault domains wala availability set
D5-245.exp: Site Recovery musalsal replicate karta hai aur har 5 minute crash-consistent point banata hai, aur recovery plan VMs tarteeb se shuru karta hai, is liye dono hadein poori hoti hain. Rozana backup aur ghante ke snapshots 15 minute se zyada khote hain, aur availability set regional outage nahi jhelta.

D5-246.q: Rozana backups 30 din aur mahana backups 12 mahine rakhe jate hain. Aaj aap ko theek 45 din pehle wali file chahiye. Kya restore ho sakta hai?
opts: Theek 45 din pehle ka rozana backup
Sirf 30 din se purane mahana points
Pichle 12 mahinon ka koi bhi din
D5-246.exp: 30 din se purane rozana points delete ho chuke. Purani tareekhon ke liye sirf mahana points bachte hain, is liye apni tareekh ke qareeb ka mahana point restore karein. Rozana retention is hisaab se rakhein ke kitne din pehle tak rozana tafseel chahiye.

D5-247.q: Aaj subah ke kharab update ke baad VM jaldi restore karni hai. Aakhri backup 8 ghante pehle hua, aur instant restore 2 din hai. Restore tez kyun hai?
opts: Woh snapshot use hota hai jo abhi disks ke sath rakha hai
Vault ka archive tier use hota hai
Paired region se sirf badli hui files copy hoti hain
VM ki temporary disk use hoti hai
D5-247.exp: Instant restore ke arse mein recovery point local snapshot ki surat mein maujood hota hai, is liye data pehle vault se copy nahi karna parta. Us ke baad restore vault se hota hai aur zyada waqt leta hai. Archive sab se sust hai.

D5-248.q: 09:00 par ransomware hamla hua, 13:00 par pata chala ke replicated VMs dono regions mein encrypt hain. Site Recovery 24 ghante ke recovery points rakhta hai. Wahan sab se behtar kya hai?
opts: Latest recovery point par fail over
09:00 se pehle ke custom recovery point par fail over
Latest processed recovery point par test failover
VMs ko source region ki taraf re-protect
D5-248.exp: Replication kharab data bhi copy karti hai, is liye taza points encrypted hain. Hamle se pehle ka custom recovery point abhi maujood hai, kyunke retention 24 ghante hai. Aise hamlon se lambi hifazat ke liye Azure Backup bhi rakhein.

D5-249.q: Har zaroorat ko term se match karein.
items: App 2 ghante mein dobara chale
Zyada se zyada 15 minute ka data jaye
Backups 7 saal tak mil saken
D5-249.exp: RTO yeh hai ke kitni der band reh sakte hain, RPO yeh ke kitna data ja sakta hai, aur retention yeh ke recovery points kitna arsa rahein. Backup kitni dafa hota hai RPO tay karta hai, retention alag chuni jati hai.

D5-250.q: West Europe ka Recovery Services vault GRS hai aur cross-region restore on hai. VM1 (West Europe) ka backup kal raat hua. Dopahar ko poora region band hota hai. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: VM1 paired region North Europe mein restore ho sakti hai
Kal raat ke baad VM1 ne jo likha sab restore ho sakta hai
Cross-region restore VM1 ko khud start karta hai
Site Recovery ka RTO kam hota
D5-250.exp: Cross-region restore se aap khud VM1 ko paired region mein wahan copy hue recovery points se restore karte hain. Secondary region peeche ho sakta hai, aur aakhri point ke baad ka kuch restore nahi hota. Site Recovery replicated disks tayyar rakhta hai, is liye fail over restore se tez hai.

D5-251.q: Aap Log Analytics table ko Analytics plan se Auxiliary plan par karte hain. Us table ke alert rules ka kya hoga?
opts: Chalte rahenge lekin har query mehngi hogi
Us table ke liye kaam karna chhor denge
D5-251.exp: Table Analytics se Auxiliary par jane par us ke alerts kaam nahi karte. Saste plans us data ke liye hain jo kam query hota hai. Alerts wali tables Analytics plan mein rakhein.

D5-252.q: Ek Log Analytics table ka plan kitni dafa badla ja sakta hai?
D5-252.exp: Table ka plan hafte mein ek dafa badla ja sakta hai, is liye soch kar chunein. Badalne se pehle dekhein table kaun use karta hai: kuch features, jaise alerts, har plan par nahi chalte, aur saste plans ki queries ka alag bill aata hai.

D5-253.q: 90 din analytics retention wali table Basic plan par ki jati hai. Total retention wahi rehti hai. 30 din se purane data ka kya hoga?
D5-253.exp: Total retention nahi badalti, lekin Basic plan mein 30 din se purana data long-term retention gina jata hai. Us ki query search job waghera se hoti hai, extra kharche ke sath. Data gum nahi hota.

D5-254.q: Azure file share ke backups storage account delete hone par bhi bachne chahiye. Kaun sa backup configure karenge?
D5-254.exp: Snapshots share wale storage account mein hi hote hain, is liye us ke sath jate hain. Vaulted backup data vault mein copy karta hai, jahan se doosri jagah restore ho sakta hai. Blob soft delete file shares ke liye nahi.

D5-255.q: Azure file shares ke backups ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Snapshot backup mein data vault mein copy hota hai
Snapshot se restore aam tor par vault se tez hota hai
Vaulted backup pehle ke baad sirf badle hue blocks bhejta hai
File shares Recovery Services vault se protect hote hain

D5-256.exp: Metric alert resource group ya subscription ki tamam VMs par lag sakta hai aur baad mein aane wali VMs bhi shamil hoti hain, is liye ek hi rule sambhalna hai. Script har nayi VM par dobara chalani parti hai, aur Service Health Azure ke masle batata hai, CPU nahi.

D5-260.exp: Instant restore ke liye snapshots 3 din rakhe jate hain. Backups 08:00 se 12 ghante tak har 4 ghante chalte hain, is liye raat ka waqfa 4 ghante se zyada hai. Weekly points (Sunday) 12 hafte rehte hain. Din mein kai backups ke liye Enhanced policy chahiye.
